context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Europe > COVID-19 pandemic in Spain, 2020 Spain coronavirus lockdown
text: Pere Aragonès, Vice President of Catalonia, confirms via Twitter he tested positive for the virus.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Europe > COVID-19 pandemic in the Netherlands
text: The Government closes down all schools and Horeca establishments, and the Royal Dutch Football Association suspends all football matches until April 6.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Europe > COVID-19 pandemic in Austria, 2020 Tyrol coronavirus lockdown
text: Günther Platter, the governor of the Austrian state of Tyrol, announces a statewide lockdown set to last for one week, out of concerns of the coronavirus.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Europe > COVID-19 pandemic in Germany
text: Germany closes its borders with France, Switzerland, Austria, Denmark and Luxembourg.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Europe > COVID-19 pandemic in Slovenia
text: Slovenia closes all schools indefintely and suspends public transport effective midnight as COVID-19 cases rise to 219.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Europe > COVID-19 pandemic in Liechtenstein
text: The government announces a tightening of the measures: all the events with more than five people are banned, including religious services, entertainment and leisure businesses are suspended, in particular museums, libraries, sport facilities, casinos and the mountain railways. Restaurants, bars, discos and nightclubs are also closed, although take-away service will be allowed.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Canada
text: Canada's public health agency posts an advert for nurses, citing "an urgent need". Prime Minister Justin Trudeau says he does not rule out the possibility of closing the borders.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in the United States
text: The American Centers for Disease Control and Prevention issues a recommendation to suspend gatherings of 50 or more people for the next two months.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in the United States
text: The governors of five states: California, Ohio, Illinois, Washington and Massachusetts, order bars and restaurants to close in response to the pandemic.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in the United States > COVID-19 pandemic in Ohio
text: The Ohio Department of Health reports it now has 37 cases of COVID-19 in the state.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in the United States > COVID-19 pandemic in New York (state)
text: New York City Mayor Bill de Blasio orders the city's public schools close until April 20.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in the United States > COVID-19 pandemic in Michigan
text: Michigan Governor Gretchen Whitmer reports the state now has 20 more confirmed cases of COVID-19 than yesterday, for a total of 53.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in the United States > COVID-19 pandemic in Arkansas
text: Arkansas Governor Asa Hutchinson announces the closing of all public schools in the state beginning March 17 over coronavirus concerns.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Turkey
text: Turkey's Presidential Communications Director Fahrettin Altun reports 12 new confirmed cases, totalling 18.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Guatemala
text: Guatemala reports the country's first death from the coronavirus, an 85-year-old man who had recently returned from Spain.

context: 2020 Democratic Party presidential primaries, 2020 Democratic Party presidential debates
text: The first one-on-one debate of the 2020 Democratic presidential primaries takes place between former Vice President Joe Biden and Senator Bernie Sanders in Washington, D.C., instead of Arizona as originally scheduled and without an audience as a result of the ongoing coronavirus pandemic.
Georgia postpones its primary elections to May 19 after 66 cases of COVID-19 were reported in the state.

The Royal Household of Spain announces that the King has refused the heritage of his father after emeritus King Juan Carlos I had been involved in a tax haven scandal and money-laundering. His public fund is also withdrawn.
A SpaceX Falcon 9 rocket aborts takeoff shortly after igniting its engines.
National Football League players vote to ratify a proposed CBA rule that changes the NFL regular season to seventeen games and the playoff format to seven games.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on television, Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on cinema
text: Actors Idris Elba and Kristofer Hivju reveal they have both tested positive for COVID-19.
An ancient petroglyph has been discovered in Central Iran.

context: Economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in the United States, 2020 stock market crash
text: Asian markets fall substantially and European markets open with huge losses. S&P futures fall 5%, triggering a trading halt in response to the Federal Reserve's emergency measures.

context: Economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in the United States, 2020 stock market crash
text: The Dow closes 2,997 points or 12.9% lower - its largest daily points movement.

context: Economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic
text: Renault announces that it is halting all production at its industrial sites in France until further notice because of the coronavirus pandemic.

context: Economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic
text: The 2020 Dayton Hamvention, the world's largest amateur radio convention, is cancelled due to the coronavirus pandemic.
Kaiser Permanente Washington Health Research Institute in Seattle begins testing a possible COVID-19 vaccine on 45 people.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Europe > COVID-19 pandemic in Spain, 2020 Spain coronavirus lockdown
text: Regional presidents of the Community of Madrid, Isabel Díaz Ayuso, and Catalonia, Quim Torra, test positive for COVID-19, as both regions are the most affected by the pandemic in the country.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Europe > COVID-19 pandemic in Spain, 2020 Spain coronavirus lockdown
text: The Spanish government takes control of all private hospitals to help the country's healthcare system cope with the virus pandemic.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Europe > COVID-19 pandemic in Spain, 2020 Spain coronavirus lockdown
text: Basque and Galician elections, both scheduled for 5 April are postponed until the crisis is overcome.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Europe > COVID-19 pandemic in Spain, 2020 Spain coronavirus lockdown
text: The Ministry of the Interior closes all borders.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Europe > COVID-19 pandemic in Poland
text: Poland's Environment Minister tests positive for COVID-19. Other Cabinet ministers' workers self-isolate but later test negative.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Europe > COVID-19 pandemic in Greenland
text: Greenland reports its first confirmed case of COVID-19, in Nuuk.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Europe > COVID-19 pandemic in Finland
text: Finland's Prime Minister Sanna Marin declares a state of emergency and closes all schools until April 13 in response to the coronavirus.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Europe > COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom
text: The first death from COVID-19 is confirmed in Wales. The 68-year-old patient was being treated at Wrexham Maelor Hospital.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Europe > COVID-19 pandemic in Armenia
text: Armenia declares a state of emergency lasting until April 14 to prevent the spread of the coronavirus. The emergency measures include the closure of all educational institutions, closing the borders with Georgia and Iran, banning gatherings with over 20 people, and postponing the 2020 Armenian constitutional referendum.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Europe > COVID-19 pandemic in Malta
text: Prime Minister Robert Abela announces the closing of all public locals but refuses to order a lockdown.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Europe > COVID-19 pandemic in Andorra
text: The COVID-19 cases in Andorra amount to 14 after a rise of 9 on the day with the highest cases registered. Prime Minister also announces the stoppage of construction and industry for 8 days.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Europe > COVID-19 pandemic in Monaco
text: Head of the Monegasque government Serge Telle tests positive for COVID-19.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Europe > COVID-19 pandemic in Iceland
text: All schools including primary and preschool in the Reykjavík area closes.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Bahrain
text: Bahrain reports the country's first death from COVID-19, a 65-year-old woman who returned from Iran last month.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Israel
text: Israel’s Health Ministry approves experimental treatment for COVID-19.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Africa
text: Benin, Liberia, Somalia and Tanzania report their first confirmed cases of COVID-19.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Africa > COVID-19 pandemic in Sudan
text: Sudan declares the emergency status.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Iran
text: Grand Ayatollah Hashem Bathaie Golpayenagi dies two days after testing positive for COVID-19, as Iran's Ministry of Health and Medical Education reports 129 more deaths from the virus.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Iran
text: Economist and social activist Fariborz Raisdana also dies from coronavirus.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Turkey
text: Turkey's Directorate of Religious Affairs imposes a nationwide ban on all prayer gatherings in mosques.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Turkey
text: Turkey's Ministry of Health confirms 29 new cases, totalling to 47.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Russia
text: Russian government has decided to provisionally limit the entry of foreigners into Russia to prevent the spread of COVID-19. The rules will come to force on Wednesday and will last until May 1. Diplomats, those "residing permanently in Russia", along with some other categories e.g. crews of aircraft, international truck drivers and people who attend funerals are exempted.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in the United States
text: The U.S. has 4,459 confirmed cases of COVID-19 as of today, resulting in 86 deaths. West Virginia remains the only state with no confirmed cases.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in the United States
text: All K–12 schools are closed in 37 U.S. states as of today, affecting a total of 37.4 million students in 72,000 schools.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in the United States
text: The San Francisco Bay Area orders a shelter in place for six counties.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in the United States
text: The governors of New York, New Jersey, Connecticut, Michigan, Louisiana, Ohio, Illinois, Massachusetts, and Washington, and mayors of cities in other states, order the closure of all bars and restaurants and ban gatherings of 50 or more people in their states or cities in response to the pandemic.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in the Netherlands
text: Prime Minister Mark Rutte becomes the first Prime Minister since 1973 to hold a rare televised address to the nation concerning the coronavirus pandemic.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Canada
text: Prime Minister Justin Trudeau announces that Canada will close its borders to all foreign travelers due to the pandemic, effective on Wednesday. Exceptions will be made for air crews, diplomats, immediate family members and U.S. citizens. Only four airports will continue to receive international flights: Toronto Pearson, Vancouver, Montréal–Trudeau, and Calgary. Domestic flights and flights from the United States, Mexico, and the Caribbean, as well as foreign commerce and trade, will not be affected.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in the Philippines
text: Philippine President Rodrigo Duterte declares a Luzon-wide "enhanced community quarantine" during the second day of the already community quarantined Metro Manila.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in the Philippines
text: Philippine Senator Migz Zubiri becomes one of the 142 cases of COVID-19 in the Philippines after his test results return positive.
A court in Japan sentences Satoshi Uematsu to death for one of the country's worst mass murders, in which he killed 19 disabled people.
The Constitutional Court of Russia approves amendments to the Constitution proposed by President Vladimir Putin.

context: Mass shootings in the United States
text: A man shoots six people, killing four and himself, at a gas station in Springfield, Missouri.
Joe Biden is declared winner of the Washington Democratic primary.

context: Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on sports > 2020 Major League Baseball season
text: Major League Baseball announces that the season will be postponed indefinitely, after the recommendations from the CDC to restrict events of more than 50 people for the next eight weeks.

context: Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on sports
text: The National Junior College Athletic Association cancels the remainder of all winter seasons, plus the spring seasons, for all sports.

context: Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on sports > WrestleMania 36
text: WWE announces that this year's edition of its flagship event, WrestleMania, will be moved from Raymond James Stadium in Tampa, Florida, to the WWE Performance Center in Orlando, Florida, without a live crowd.

context: Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on sports > 2020 NFL Draft
text: The 2020 NFL draft will go ahead in April despite the coronavirus, but with new changes.

context: Economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic
text: The Italian government announces it will take over the flag carrier Alitalia as part of its emergency response to the coronavirus pandemic.

context: Economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic
text: British textile design company Laura Ashley plc collapses into administration, saying the coronavirus has had a "significant impact on trading".

British multinational electrical and telecommunications retailer Dixons Carphone says it is closing all standalone Carphone Warehouse stores in the UK, with the loss of 2,900 jobs, as part of a company restructuring. The closures are not believed to be related to the ongoing coronavirus pandemic.
Pfizer signs a deal with to help develop a vaccine.
China gives go-ahead for human trials for a potential vaccine.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > 2020 coronavirus pandemic in Asia > COVID-19 pandemic in mainland China
text: Wuhan, where the coronavirus originated, will require returnees to be quarantined for 14 days.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > 2020 coronavirus pandemic in Asia > COVID-19 pandemic in mainland China
text: China reports only one domestic case of COVID-19, but found 20 cases that were imported abroad.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > 2020 coronavirus pandemic in Asia > 2020 coronavirus pandemic in Japan
text: The President of the Japan Football Association and deputy Olympic Committee chief Kozo Tashima tests positive for COVID-19. Japan insists the 2020 Summer Olympics will still go ahead as planned.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > 2020 coronavirus pandemic in Australia
text: A 37-year-old Woolworths employee is stabbed by a 25-year-old man in Rosebud, Victoria. The crime is believed to be related to mass panic buying across Australian supermarkets that has seen cases of violence between shoppers and staff members. ([https://www.news.com.au/national/victoria/news/man-allegedly-stabbed-in-woolies-in-victorias-mornington-peninsula/news-story/4817e2e2bec6798855857ac048937e3f News.com.au])

context: COVID-19 pandemic > 2020 coronavirus pandemic in Malaysia
text: Malaysia reports its first two deaths from COVID-19 as the total number of confirmed cases in the country rises to 673. The victims of the virus were a 60-year-old from Kuching and a 34-year-old from Johor.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > 2020 coronavirus pandemic in Iran
text: Iran temporarily frees 85,000 prisoners, including political ones and British-Iranian dual national Nazanin Zaghari-Ratcliffe, amid the coronavirus outbreak in the country. A judiciary spokesman says all of those freed were serving less than five years in prison, while all other prisoners serving heavier sentences remain in jail.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > 2020 coronavirus pandemic in Iran
text: Iran's Ministry of Health and Medical Education reports 1,178 new confirmed cases of COVID-19 and 135 more deaths, bringing the total to 16,169 cases and 988 deaths.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > 2020 coronavirus pandemic in Iran
text: Sharif University publishes a study about the number of possible casualties, warning that it could reach millions of deaths if a full quarantine is not imposed.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > 2020 coronavirus pandemic in Iran
text: Iran bans the traditional Persian fire festival Chaharshanbe Suri.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > 2020 coronavirus pandemic in Europe
text: The European Union closes its external border for first time in its history.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > 2020 coronavirus pandemic in Europe > 2020 coronavirus pandemic in Italy
text: Former Prime Minister Silvio Berlusconi announces a 10 million euros donation to Lombardy to arrange a temporary 400-bed hospital at Milan trade fair. ([http://www.ansa.it/english/news/politics/2020/03/17/berlusconi-gives-10-mn-to-lombardy_699fb725-fa9a-4b54-addd-6133e6a98c45.html ANSA])

context: COVID-19 pandemic > 2020 coronavirus pandemic in Europe > 2020 coronavirus pandemic in Spain
text: Spain's Ministry of Health reports 2,000 more confirmed cases of COVID-19 and 182 more deaths, raising the total to 11,178 cases and 491 deaths. The Balearic Islands regional government asks tourists to return home and closes airports and ports.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > 2020 coronavirus pandemic in Europe > 2020 coronavirus pandemic in Bosnia and Herzegovina
text: Bosnia and Herzegovina declares a state of emergency over COVID-19. The Bosnian military is directed to set up tent quarantines on the border with Republika Srpska, which itself has declared a state of emergency.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > 2020 coronavirus pandemic in Europe > 2020 coronavirus pandemic in Montenegro
text: Montenegro reports its first two confirmed cases of COVID-19 in two female patients who had recently returned from abroad.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > 2020 coronavirus pandemic in Europe > 2020 coronavirus pandemic in Monaco
text: For first time in his reign, Albert II addresses to the Nation in a serious speech reporting on the strengthening of quarantine measures.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > 2020 coronavirus pandemic in Brazil
text: Brazil records their first death from COVID-19 in São Paulo state.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > 2020 coronavirus pandemic in Brazil
text: Hundreds of inmates escape from a prison in Mongaguá after rioting over new coronavirus restrictions. Riots and escapes are also reported at prisons in Mirandópolis, Porto Feliz and Tremembé with as many as 1,000 prisoners on the loose; at least 174 have been recaptured by police.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > 2020 coronavirus pandemic in the United States
text: The U.S. reports its 105th death from COVID-19 (54 of them in Washington state) with a total of at least 5,748 confirmed cases nationwide.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > 2020 coronavirus pandemic in the United States
text: As of today, 91,000 American K–12 schools are closed in 39 states, affecting 41.6 million students and their families.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > 2020 coronavirus pandemic in the United States > 2020 coronavirus pandemic in South Carolina
text: After 47 cases of COVID-19 are confirmed in the state, outgoing Chief of Staff Mick Mulvaney goes under self-quarantine in South Carolina.
sources: South Carolina Department of Health and Environmental Control

context: COVID-19 pandemic > 2020 coronavirus pandemic in the United States > 2020 coronavirus pandemic in Michigan
text: Michigan reports 11 more confirmed cases of COVID-19 than yesterday, for a total of 65.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > 2020 coronavirus pandemic in the United States > 2020 coronavirus pandemic in Alabama
text: Alabama reports a total of 39 cases of COVID-19 and announces the prohibition of gatherings of 25 people or more in six counties.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > 2020 coronavirus pandemic in the United States > 2020 coronavirus pandemic in New York (state)
text: New York confirms its 12th death from COVID-19, and 1,374 cases total, 432 more than yesterday.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > 2020 coronavirus pandemic in the United States > 2020 coronavirus pandemic in West Virginia
text: West Virginia confirms its first case of COVID-19, becoming the last U.S. state to do so. Governor Jim Justice ordered restaurant dining rooms, bars, and casinos to close for two weeks.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > 2020 coronavirus pandemic in the United States > 2020 coronavirus pandemic in Arizona
text: Several cities in Arizona declare states of emergency amidst the crisis, with Phoenix and Tucson closing all bars and switching restaurants to take-out only until further notice.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > 2020 coronavirus pandemic in the United States > 2020 coronavirus pandemic in Delaware
text: Delaware confirms eight new presumptive cases of COVID-19, bringing the total of such cases to 16.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > 2020 coronavirus pandemic in the United States > 2020 coronavirus pandemic in Illinois
text: The air traffic control tower at Midway International Airport in Chicago closes after several technicians employed there tested positive for COVID-19. Chicago Air Route Traffic Control Center will control the airport and its airspace until cleaning is completed.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > 2020 coronavirus pandemic in Canada > 2020 coronavirus pandemic in Ontario
text: Ontario Premier Doug Ford announces a state of emergency, closing restaurants, day cares, and all schools.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > 2020 coronavirus pandemic in Turkey
text: Turkey reports its first death from COVID-19, while the number of confirmed cases increases to 98.

context: Accession of North Macedonia to NATO
text: The Senate of Spain ratifies North Macedonia's accession protocol for NATO, becoming the last of NATO's 30 members to do so. The move formally paves the way for North Macedonia to join the military alliance.
Hashem Abedi, the brother of Manchester Arena bomber Salman Ramadan Abedi, is found guilty of 22 murders.

context: 2020 Democratic Party presidential primaries, 2020 Republican Party presidential primaries
text: Voters in Arizona, Florida, and Illinois go to the polls in their primary elections.

context: 2020 Democratic Party presidential primaries, 2020 Republican Party presidential primaries
text: Former U.S. Vice President Joe Biden wins all three states, increasing his delegate count to 1,180, while U.S. Senator Bernie Sanders now has 885. The minimum required to win the nomination is 1,991.

context: 2020 Democratic Party presidential primaries, 2020 Republican Party presidential primaries
text: Incumbent U.S. President Donald Trump wins enough delegates to clinch the Republican nomination.

context: 2020 Democratic Party presidential primaries, 2020 Republican Party presidential primaries > Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on politics
text: Maryland postpones its primary from April 28 to June 2, becoming the fifth state to do so.

context: 2020 Democratic Party presidential primaries, 2020 Republican Party presidential primaries > Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on politics
text: Ohio was scheduled to vote today, but the election was postponed until June 2 due to the coronavirus pandemic. The delay capped hours of confusion in which the election was called off by the state's governor, Mike DeWine, only for a judge to then rule that he did not have the authority to do so. The state's health director, Amy Acton, then called off the election on the grounds of a health emergency.

Sophie Wilmès is sworn in as Prime Minister of Belgium. Seven opposition parties have pledged to support the minority government—in its previous composition—with plenary power for three to six months to handle the coronavirus pandemic in Belgium.

context: Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on sports
text: UEFA postpones the Euro 2020 association football tournament until summer 2021 in response to the coronavirus pandemic in Europe.

context: Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on sports
text: CONMEBOL postpones the Copa America 2020 association football tournament until 2021 in response to the coronavirus pandemic.

context: Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on sports
text: The 2020 French Open tennis tournament is postponed until late September.

context: Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on sports > 2019–20 NBA season
text: Brooklyn Nets player Kevin Durant and three of his teammates test positive for COVID-19.
Longtime New England Patriots quarterback Tom Brady announces he will not re-sign with the team, and will instead select free agency.
The Eurovision Song Contest 2020, which is due to be held in the Netherlands, is cancelled for the first time on the event's 64-year history due to the spread of COVID-19.

context: Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on religion
text: The Greek Orthodox Ecumenical Patriarchate of Constantinople issues a worldwide suspension of all "divine services, events, and rites, with the exception of private prayer in churches that will remain open, until the end of March".

context: Economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic > List of events affected by the COVID-19 pandemic, Economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom
text: The 2020 Glastonbury Festival, scheduled for June 24–28, is cancelled due to the coronavirus pandemic.

context: Economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic > Economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic in the United States
text: U.S. President Donald Trump suspends all foreclosures and evictions, and invokes the Defense Production Act to address shortages of supplies needed for responding to the coronavirus outbreak in the country.

context: Economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic > Economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic in the United States
text: The U.S. Treasury Department says it will ask Congress for $500 billion in direct payouts for taxpayers in order to combat the economic effects of the coronavirus pandemic. Under the current proposal, the payouts will consist of two tiered payments, with the amounts of each based on income level and family size.

context: Economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic > Economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic in the United States
text: Unemployment in the United States could reach 20 percent if sufficient action is not taken in responding to the coronavirus pandemic, Treasury Secretary Steven Mnuchin warns.

context: Economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic > Economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic in the United States
text: The U.S. Senate approves the Families First Coronavirus Response Act, an emergency relief aid bill, in response to the coronavirus pandemic. The bill will ensure that people who are employed in places with less than 500 employees will receive paid benefits while on leave. It also offers free testing for uninsured people and expands federal funding for medical coverage.

context: Economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic > Economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic in the United States
text: President Trump signs the Families First Coronavirus Response Act into law to provide economic relief to families affected by the coronavirus pandemic.

An earthquake with a magnitude of 5.7 hits Salt Lake City, Utah, with several aftershocks reported and tens of thousands of residents left without power. The earthquake is the largest in the state since the 1992 St. George earthquake.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on education
text: More than 850 million students are not attending school due to the coronavirus pandemic, according to UNESCO.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Africa > COVID-19 pandemic in The Gambia
text: The Gambia reports its first confirmed case of COVID-19, a female patient in her 20s who recently returned from the United Kingdom. The patient is in isolation at a clinic in Fajara.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Africa > COVID-19 pandemic in Burkina Faso
text: Burkina Faso reports its first death from COVID-19, a 62-year-old diabetic woman.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Africa > COVID-19 pandemic in Djibouti
text: Djibouti reports its first confirmed case of COVID-19, a member of Spain's Special Operations Groups who arrived at Djibouti–Ambouli International Airport on March 14.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Iran
text: Iran's Ministry of Health and Medical Education says the country's COVID-19 death toll stands at 1,135 following 147 more deaths. The total number of cases rises to 17,361.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Europe > COVID-19 pandemic in Italy
text: In Italy, the coronavirus death toll rises to 2,978. A total of 35,713 people have the virus in the country.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Europe > COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom
text: All schools in Scotland and Wales are to close, effective March 19, in response to the coronavirus pandemic.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Europe > COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom
text: The COVID-19 death toll in the United Kingdom surpasses 100.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Europe > COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom
text: The United Kingdom advises its citizens vacationing in Spain to return home due to the coronavirus pandemic.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Europe > COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom
text: The British government’s Department of Health and Social Care confirms an additional 676 cases of COVID-19 within 24 hours.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Europe > COVID-19 pandemic in Spain, 2020 Spain coronavirus lockdown
text: King Felipe VI of Spain addresses the nation in a special speech for the second time in his reign, and the sixth by a monarch in the democracy’s 40 years. Focusing on the coronavirus pandemic, he gives his appreciation for the work of health personnel and calls for a break in differences, stating that Spaniards can "defeat this crisis" through unification.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Europe > COVID-19 pandemic in Portugal
text: Portuguese President Marcelo Rebelo de Sousa declares a state of emergency, the first in the country in 45 years, due to the coronavirus pandemic. [https://www.politico.eu/article/portugal-declares-state-of-emergency-coronavirus-covid19-antonio-costa/ (Politico Europe])

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in North America
text: The United States and Canada suspend nonessential travel between the two countries due to the coronavirus pandemic.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in North America > COVID-19 pandemic in the United States
text: The United States reports its 150th death from COVID-19, with a total of at least 9,400 confirmed cases nationwide.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in North America > COVID-19 pandemic in the United States > Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on education
text: In the United States, several K–12 school systems will keep their learning facilities physically closed for the remainder of the academic school year due to the coronavirus pandemic, resulting in 92,000 American schools across 39 states, and 42.1 million students and their families, transitioning to online learning, while some systems will not calculate grades at all.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in North America > COVID-19 pandemic in the United States > COVID-19 pandemic in Michigan
text: Michigan reports its first death from COVID-19, as the state reaches 110 recorded cases.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in North America > COVID-19 pandemic in the United States > COVID-19 pandemic in New York, COVID-19 pandemic in Washington
text: COVID-19 cases in Washington exceed 1,000.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in North America > COVID-19 pandemic in the United States > COVID-19 pandemic in New York, COVID-19 pandemic in Washington
text: The U.S. Navy will deploy a hospital ship to New York City to aid in the response to COVID-19.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in North America > COVID-19 pandemic in the United States > COVID-19 pandemic in New York, COVID-19 pandemic in Washington
text: A hospital ship will be deployed to the coast of Washington state by the U.S. Navy to assist in the response to COVID-19.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Turkey
text: Turkey reports its second death from COVID-19, a 61-year-old male patient, while the number of confirmed cases rises to 191.
The Abortion Legislation Bill 2019 passes its third reading in the New Zealand House of Representatives, legalising abortion in New Zealand.

context: 2020 United States elections > 2020 United States House of Representatives elections > 2020 United States House of Representatives elections in Illinois
text: In a major upset in the 2020 U.S. House of Representatives elections in Illinois, Democrat Marie Newman defeats conservative Democrat Dan Lipinski in Illinois's 3rd congressional district.

context: 2020 United States elections > 2020 Democratic Party presidential primaries
text: U.S. Senator Bernie Sanders says he will assess his presidential campaign after losing three more states (Florida, Illinois, and Arizona) to former Vice President Joe Biden in the Democratic primaries of the 2020 presidential election. Biden has 1,181 delegates, while Sanders has 885. The minimum required to win the nomination is 1,991.

context: 2020 United States elections > 2020 Republican Party presidential primaries, Bill Weld 2020 presidential campaign
text: Former Massachusetts Governor Bill Weld ends his presidential campaign for the Republican nomination in the 2020 U.S. presidential election.

context: Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on politics > COVID-19 pandemic in Kosovo
text: Prime Minister of Kosovo Albin Kurti sacks Interior Minister Agim Veliu over disagreements regarding a state of emergency in response to the coronavirus pandemic.

context: Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on politics > 2020 United States Senate election in Alabama
text: Alabama postpones its Republican Party Senate primary to July 14 due to coronavirus concerns.

context: Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on politics
text: The White House postpones a state visit from Spain's King Felipe VI and Queen Letizia due to the coronavirus pandemic.

context: Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on politics
text: U.S. Republican Representative Mario Diaz-Balart of Florida tests positive for COVID-19.

SpaceX successfully launches and deploys 60 Starlink satellites on a Falcon 9 rocket. The Falcon 9 rocket, making a record fifth launch, misses the autonomous spaceport drone ship Of Course I Still Love You, crashing in the Atlantic Ocean.

context: Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on sports > 2020 AFL season, COVID-19 pandemic in Australia
text: The 2020 Australian Football League season opener between Richmond Football Club and Carlton Football Club will go on as planned despite the coronavirus outbreak.
New England Patriots quarterback Tom Brady leaves the team after 20 seasons and, pending contract stipulations, will sign with the Tampa Bay Buccaneers.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on television
text: Actor Daniel Dae Kim tests positive for COVID-19.
The wreckage of the USS Stickleback is discovered off the Hawaiian Island of Oahu.

context: Economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic, COVID-19 pandemic in the United States
text: U.S. Senate Republicans unveil a $1 trillion economic stimulus package proposal to aid businesses and the American public during the coronavirus pandemic.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Europe
text: The European Union's chief Brexit negotiator, Michel Barnier, tests positive for COVID-19.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Europe > COVID-19 pandemic in Italy
text: In Italy, the military is deployed to the city of Bergamo, Lombardy, the Italian city worst hit by COVID-19, to collect and transport the bodies of dead residents to crematoriums in other cities, as Bergamo’s authorities say their facilities can no longer process the large number of fatalities. The city's mayor Giorgio Gori says the true number of dead could be much higher than what's been reported.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Europe > COVID-19 pandemic in Italy
text: The number of confirmed COVID-19 deaths in Italy overtakes the number in China, as 3,405 are now confirmed dead due to the virus.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Europe > COVID-19 pandemic in Italy
text: Marcello Natali, a doctor from Italy known for exposing the country's chronic shortage of medical supplies, dies from the coronavirus. The Italian Federation of General Practitioners confirms his death.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Europe > COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom
text: Northern Ireland confirms its first death from COVID-19, an elderly man with an underlying medical condition who was being treated at a hospital in Greater Belfast.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Europe > COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom
text: The COVID-19 death toll in the United Kingdom rises to 144.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Europe > COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom
text: The British government introduces the Coronavirus Bill 2019–21, which would grant it extensive discretionary emergency powers in managing the coronavirus pandemic.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Europe > COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom
text: The British government puts 20,000 British Army reservists on standby to help with the coronavirus pandemic.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Europe > COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom
text: Transport for London announces the closure of 40 train stations, including London Waterloo station and the Hammersmith & City line.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Europe > COVID-19 pandemic in Monaco
text: Albert II, Prince of Monaco, tests positive for COVID-19, becoming the world's first head of state to test positive for the virus.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Europe > COVID-19 pandemic in Spain
text: Spain's Ministry of Health says the country’s COVID-19 death toll has risen to 767, with 169 more deaths and 3,431 new confirmed cases, for a total of 17,147 cases.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Asia > COVID-19 pandemic in Hubei, COVID-19 pandemic in mainland China
text: China, in its daily National Health Commission report, lists no new domestic COVID-19 cases for the first time since the coronavirus pandemic began in Wuhan.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Asia > COVID-19 pandemic in Iran
text: Iran's Ministry of Health and Medical Education reports 149 more COVID-19 deaths and an additional 1,046 cases, bringing the death toll in the country to 1,284 and its total number of cases to 18,407.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Asia > COVID-19 pandemic in Nepal
text: Nepalese government orders the suspension of all classes and the postponement of all academic examinations.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Oceania > COVID-19 pandemic in Australia
text: Australia closes its borders to all non-Australian residents.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Oceania > COVID-19 pandemic in Australia
text: Australian Prime Minister Scott Morrison says about A$100 billion will be injected into the Australian economy to support it during the coronavirus pandemic.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Oceania > COVID-19 pandemic in Fiji
text: Fiji reports its first confirmed case of COVID-19, a male patient in Lautoka.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Russia
text: Russia reports its first death from COVID-19. Moscow city authorities say the victim was a 79-year-old woman with underlying health conditions.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in North America > COVID-19 pandemic in the United States
text: The number of COVID-19 cases in the United States surpasses 10,000, with 13,229 confirmed cases. The death toll stands at 195.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in North America > COVID-19 pandemic in the United States
text: The U.S. State Department warns American citizens not to travel abroad due to the coronavirus pandemic.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in North America > COVID-19 pandemic in the United States > Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on education
text: While educational facilities close across the United States due to the coronavirus pandemic, the U.S. Department of Education tells educators that online learning must comply with civil rights laws, including making sure learning tools are available to students. However, as not every student has access to the internet, many students will be unable to participate, prompting some public school systems to implement "enrichment" policies. Under these policies, coursework completed under online learning will not officially count towards advancing to the next academic term.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in North America > COVID-19 pandemic in the United States > COVID-19 pandemic in California
text: Six counties in the San Francisco Bay Area announce shelter in place orders for all residents due to the ongoing coronavirus pandemic.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in North America > COVID-19 pandemic in the United States > COVID-19 pandemic in California
text: Los Angeles County, California, announces a near-lockdown, urging residents to stay in their homes and to only go out in public for essential needs.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in North America > COVID-19 pandemic in the United States > COVID-19 pandemic in California
text: California Governor Gavin Newsom issues a statewide stay-at-home order for all Californians except for essential errands such as grocery shopping or for medical services.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in North America > COVID-19 pandemic in the United States > COVID-19 pandemic in Michigan
text: Two more people die from COVID-19 in Michigan and the total number of cases in the state rises to 334. The two fatalities are identified as an 81-year-old and a woman in her 50s with underlying health conditions.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in North America > COVID-19 pandemic in the United States > COVID-19 pandemic in Hawaii
text: Hawaii says that it will not allow the passengers of two cruise ships heading for its coast to disembark upon arrival due to the ongoing coronavirus pandemic, despite both ships reporting zero cases of COVID-19.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in North America > COVID-19 pandemic in the United States > COVID-19 pandemic in New York
text: New York City Mayor Bill de Blasio says the city's COVID-19 death toll stands at 22, with 3,615 cases.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in North America > COVID-19 pandemic in the United States > COVID-19 pandemic in Florida
text: Florida Senator Rick Scott urges those visiting the state for spring break to stay away from public beaches to avoid the spread of the coronavirus.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in North America > COVID-19 pandemic in the United States > COVID-19 pandemic in Florida
text: In an effort to prevent those visiting the state for spring break from gathering on beaches amid the ongoing coronavirus pandemic, Florida Governor Ron DeSantis institutes Centers for Disease Control and Prevention guidelines preventing large crowds and says "the party’s over." However, he stops short of closing all public beaches in the state, despite calls for him to do so.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in North America > COVID-19 pandemic in the United States > COVID-19 pandemic in Pennsylvania
text: Pennsylvania Governor Tom Wolf orders all non-life-sustaining businesses in the state to close physical locations to slow the spread of the coronavirus.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in North America > COVID-19 pandemic in the United States > COVID-19 pandemic in Pennsylvania
text: The first COVID-19 death in Pennsylvania is reported, an adult from Northampton County. He was being treated at a hospital prior to his death. There were no specific details released on the patient or his health prior to contracting the virus.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in North America > COVID-19 pandemic in the United States > COVID-19 pandemic in Georgia (U.S. state)
text: Georgia Governor Brian Kemp says he does not plan on ordering business to close or shutting down public events amid the coronavirus pandemic.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in North America > COVID-19 pandemic in Mexico
text: Mexico reports its first death from COVID-19, a 41-year-old diabetic man.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in North America > COVID-19 pandemic in Haiti
text: Haiti confirms its first two cases of COVID-19.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in North America > COVID-19 pandemic in Haiti
text: Amid the coronavirus pandemic, Haiti declares a state of emergency. All schools, universities, industrial parks and airports will be closed from midnight, while a nationwide curfew will be in force from 8pm to 5am.
U.S. President Donald Trump calls for the Syrian government to release journalist and veteran Marine Austin Tice, arguing the "U.S. has done a lot for Syria".

According to an article published by the ProPublica, Senators Richard Burr of North Carolina, Kelly Loeffler of Georgia, Jim Inhofe of Oklahoma, and Dianne Feinstein of California sold their stocks before the stock market crash.
U.S. Representative from Hawaii Tulsi Gabbard ends her presidential campaign in the 2020 presidential election and endorses former Vice President Joe Biden.
Registered voters in Vanuatu head to the polls to elect members of parliament.

context: Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on sports > Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on basketball > 2019–20 NBA season
text: Three people employed by the Philadelphia 76ers test positive for COVID-19.

context: Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on sports > Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on association football
text: The suspension of football games in England, including the Premier League and English Football League, is extended until at least April 30 due to the continued spread of the coronavirus.

context: Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on sports > Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on gridiron football
text: Sean Payton, the head coach of the New Orleans Saints, says he has tested positive for COVID-19.

context: Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on sports > 2020 Summer Olympics torch relay
text: Despite calls for the cancelation of the 2020 Summer Olympics due to the ongoing coronavirus pandemic, Greece hands the Olympic flame over to Japan in a ceremony without spectators.

context: Economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Japan, Economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom
text: Japanese car manufacturer Nissan suspends production indefinitely at its major Nissan Motor Manufacturing UK plant in Sunderland, Tyne and Wear, over the coronavirus pandemic.

context: Economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Japan, Economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom
text: The British government announces a stimulus plan to counter the socioeconomic impacts of the coronavirus pandemic, which includes the government paying a portion of citizens' wages.

context: Economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic > Economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic in the United States
text: The United States moves Tax Day from April 15 to July 15 due to the spread of the coronavirus.

context: Economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic > Economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic in the United States
text: United Airlines announces it will cancel 95 percent of its international flights starting next month.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in South America > COVID-19 pandemic in Argentina
text: Argentina begins a mandatory national quarantine until March 31, restricting people to their homes to prevent the spread of the coronavirus. People will only be allowed to leave their homes to shop for basic goods, like food and medicine, according to President Alberto Fernández.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in South America > COVID-19 pandemic in Paraguay
text: The first death from COVID-19 is reported in Paraguay, a 69-year-old man who had been hospitalized in intensive care, while the total of those infected rises to 18.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Europe > COVID-19 pandemic in Spain
text: The death toll from COVID-19 in Spain exceeds 1,000 while the total number of those infected reaches 20,000.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Europe > COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom
text: NHS England increases the United Kingdom's COVID-19 death toll to 184. The patients who died were aged between 50 and 99 and had underlying health conditions.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Europe > COVID-19 pandemic in Poland
text: Poland declares a 'state of epidemic' amid the coronavirus pandemic, Prime Minister Mateusz Morawiecki announces at a press conference late on Friday. Two-week suspension of schools, introduced earlier this month, would be extended until after the Easter holidays. The government announces that fines for anyone breaking coronavirus quarantine increase from the current PLN 5,000 up to PLN 30,000 (EUR 6,600, USD 7,050).

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Europe > COVID-19 pandemic in Iceland
text: The first death from COVID-19 is confirmed in Iceland.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Oceania
text: Papua New Guinea reports its first confirmed case of COVID-19, a male patient from Spain currently being isolated in Lae. The country will also close its borders.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Asia > COVID-19 pandemic in Hubei, COVID-19 pandemic in mainland China
text: China reports zero domestic cases of COVID-19 for a second consecutive day.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Asia > COVID-19 pandemic in Hubei, COVID-19 pandemic in mainland China
text: The World Health Organization says China reporting zero domestic cases of COVID-19 for two days in a row should "give the world hope."

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Asia > COVID-19 pandemic in Sri Lanka
text: The Sri Lankan government imposes a nationwide curfew to contain COVID-19. Mosques across the nation are closed.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Asia > COVID-19 pandemic in Israel
text: Israel reports its first death from COVID-19, an 88-year-old Holocaust survivor with pre-existing health conditions.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Asia > COVID-19 pandemic in Iran
text: Iran's Ministry of Health and Medical Education says the country's COVID-19 death toll stands at 1,433, and confirms 1,237 new cases, bringing the total number of cases to 19,644 and 1,433 deaths.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Asia > COVID-19 pandemic in the Philippines
text: Disinfection begins in La Trinidad, the capital of the Philippines province Benguet, in an effort to contain the coronavirus.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Asia > COVID-19 pandemic in the United Arab Emirates
text: The United Arab Emirates announces its first two deaths from COVID-19.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Asia > COVID-19 pandemic in the United Arab Emirates
text: Dubai Municipality begins an 11-day sterilization campaign in an effort to contain the coronavirus.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Asia > COVID-19 pandemic in Nepal
text: In a special TV address, Prime Minister KP Sharma Oli announces the suspension of all international flights until 31 March and internal long-distance public bus routes, while orders the closure of all non-essential public and private office until 3 April.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Asia > COVID-19 pandemic in Nepal
text: The Supreme Court stops all non-urgent legal proceedings at all levels across the country. The National Assembly also suspends its activity indefinitely.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in North America > COVID-19 pandemic in Cuba
text: In an effort to further prevent the spread of COVID-19, Cuba announces a ban on tourism and most air travel, starting Tuesday. This restriction does not apply to citizens and residents.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in North America > COVID-19 pandemic in the United States > COVID-19 pandemic in Illinois
text: Illinois Governor J. B. Pritzker issues a statewide stay-at-home order for all Illinoisans except for essential errands such as grocery shopping or for medical services.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in North America > COVID-19 pandemic in the United States > COVID-19 pandemic in New York
text: New York Governor Andrew Cuomo issues a statewide stay-at-home order for all New Yorkers except for essential errands such as grocery shopping or for medical services.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in North America > COVID-19 pandemic in the United States > COVID-19 pandemic in Connecticut
text: Connecticut Governor Ned Lamont issues a statewide stay-at-home order for all Connecticuters except for essential errands such as grocery shopping or for medical services.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in North America > COVID-19 pandemic in the United States > COVID-19 pandemic in Michigan
text: A fourth death from COVID-19 is reported in Michigan, a man in his 50s with underlying health conditions in Oakland County.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in North America > COVID-19 pandemic in the United States > COVID-19 pandemic in Arizona
text: Arizona records its first death from COVID-19, a Maricopa County man in his 50s with underlying health conditions.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in North America > COVID-19 pandemic in the United States
text: The Donald Trump administration announces it will limit nonessential travel between the United States and Mexico.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in North America > COVID-19 pandemic in the United States
text: The Washington Post reports that U.S. intelligence agencies repeatedly warned President Trump about the threats posed by COVID-19 in January and February, but administration officials say they "just couldn't get him to do anything about it."

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Africa > COVID-19 pandemic in Madagascar
text: Madagascar confirms its first cases of COVID-19.
India executes four men convicted of the 2012 Delhi gang rape and murder case.
The parliament of Ghana votes to legalize the medical and industrial use of cannabis.

context: Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on sports > 2020 Summer Olympics
text: International Olympic Committee President Thomas Bach says that canceling the 2020 Summer Olympics due to the coronavirus pandemic "is not on the agenda," but says it is too early to make a decision.

context: COVID-19 pandemic in the United States > COVID-19 pandemic in Tennessee
text: The Grand Ole Opry broadcasts from an empty venue for the first time since 1925.

context: Economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic > Economy of China, COVID-19 pandemic in mainland China
text: China resumes construction of its infrastructure to help ease the economic impact of COVID-19.
The World Health Organization says at least 20 vaccines for COVID-19 are in development around the world and that clinical trials are underway.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Asia > COVID-19 pandemic in mainland China
text: China reports zero domestic cases of COVID-19 for a third consecutive day.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Asia > COVID-19 pandemic in mainland China
text: China sends masks and medical experts abroad to aid countries affected by COVID-19.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Asia > COVID-19 pandemic in East Timor
text: East Timor confirms its first case of COVID-19.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Asia > COVID-19 pandemic in Taiwan
text: Taiwan reports 18 imported cases of COVID-19.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Oceania > COVID-19 pandemic in Fiji
text: Fiji confirms its second case of COVID-19.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Africa > COVID-19 pandemic in Mauritius
text: Mauritius reports its first death from COVID-19.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Africa > COVID-19 pandemic in Angola
text: Angola reports its first confirmed cases of COVID-19, two male Angolan nationals who recently returned from Portugal.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Africa > COVID-19 pandemic in Uganda
text: Uganda reports its first confirmed case of COVID-19. The patient is a 36-year-old Ugandan male who recently arrived in the country on an Ethiopian Airlines flight from Dubai.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Europe > COVID-19 pandemic in Italy
text: Italy says an additional 793 people have died from COVID-19 in the country, bringing the death toll to 4,825. It is the highest number of deaths in a single 24-hour period in the country to date.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Europe > COVID-19 pandemic in Finland
text: Finland's National Institute for Health and Welfare reports the country's first death from COVID-19.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Europe > COVID-19 pandemic in Georgia (country)
text: Georgia declares a nationwide state of emergency due to COVID-19, effective until April 21.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Europe > COVID-19 pandemic in Spain
text: Spain's Ministry of Health reports an additional 324 COVID-19 deaths, the country's largest one-day increase. The country's death toll stands at 1,326, with 24,926 cases, the second highest in Europe.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Europe > COVID-19 pandemic in Spain
text: Spain announces it is closing hotels in the country for the sake of converting them into hospitals, as local medical facilities are being overwhelmed by COVID-19 patients. A military hospital will also be constructed in the capital Madrid.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Europe > COVID-19 pandemic in Spain
text: Lorenzo Sanz, the former president of Real Madrid CF, dies after testing positive for COVID-19.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Europe > COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom
text: The British government orders all pubs, restaurants, theaters, cinemas, gyms and other social hubs to close down to prevent the spread of the coronavirus.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Europe > COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom
text: The United Kingdom's Department of Health and Social Care confirms 53 more deaths from COVID-19, bringing the country's death toll to 233. All those who died had underlying health conditions and the oldest patient was 94-years-old, according to NHS England.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Europe > COVID-19 pandemic in Albania
text: Albania's government deploys troops to enforce a 40-hour nationwide curfew. Prime Minister Edi Rama says Albanians "will stay inside after 13:00", and that police and the armed forces "will use force against whoever breaks the law, including pensioners, and will use water canons and tear gas if need be."

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Europe > COVID-19 pandemic in France
text: France reports 112 more deaths from COVID-19, bringing the country's death toll to 562. There are 1,525 people in severe condition with the virus, half of which are people under the age of 60.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Europe > COVID-19 pandemic in Turkey
text: Turkey's Ministry of the Interior imposes a curfew for people over the age of 65 and the chronically ill.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Europe > COVID-19 pandemic in Turkey
text: Turkey's Ministry of Health reports that the country's COVID-19 death toll stands at 21, with 947 confirmed cases.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Europe > COVID-19 pandemic in Cyprus
text: Cyprus reports its first death from COVID-19.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in North America > COVID-19 pandemic in the United States
text: Ketchikan, in Southeast Alaska, shelters in place after six people test positive for COVID-19 in the town of 8,000 residents.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in North America > COVID-19 pandemic in the United States > COVID-19 pandemic in Michigan
text: Michigan says eight people have died from COVID-19.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in South America > COVID-19 pandemic in Chile
text: Chile's Ministry of Health reports its country's first COVID-19 death in an 83-year woman from Renca, Santiago. The country has more than 500 confirmed cases, the second-largest number in South America after Brazil.

context: North Korea–South Korea relations, North Korea and weapons of mass destruction
text: Yonhap News Agency reports that North Korea has fired two projectiles from Pyongan Province into the Sea of Japan.
North Korea says that U.S. President Donald Trump wrote a letter to Supreme Leader Kim Jong-un to express his willingness to work with him on dealing with COVID-19.
Vice President Mike Pence and his wife Karen Pence test negative for COVID-19.

context: Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on sports
text: Football player Wu Lei, a Chinese national based in Spain, tests positive for COVID-19. He says he is recovering from the virus.
Pope Francis, in a call for a worldwide prayer, announces he will hold a special service to pray for the end of the coronavirus pandemic.

context: Economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in the United Arab Emirates
text: Dubai-based airline Emirates announces that it will be suspending all passenger flights effective March 25 in response to the coronavirus pandemic, but will continue to operate cargo flights for essential goods.

context: Economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic > Economy of the United States, COVID-19 pandemic in the United States
text: The U.S. Senate votes down a coronavirus relief stimulus bill.

context: Economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic > Economy of the United States, COVID-19 pandemic in the United States
text: U.S. Senate Majority Leader Mitch McConnell is expected to set up a second vote on a coronavirus relief stimulus bill for Monday.
A 5.3-magnitude earthquake hits Zagreb, Croatia. Seventeen people are injured; one passes away. The earthquake is Zagreb's largest since 1880.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Asia > COVID-19 pandemic in India
text: India observes a 14-hour nationwide self-imposed Janata Curfew amid the coronavirus pandemic.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Asia > COVID-19 pandemic in India
text: India suspends the entry of international flights due to the coronavirus.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Asia > COVID-19 pandemic in the Palestinian territories
text: The Palestinian National Authority confirms the first cases of COVID-19 in the Gaza Strip. Both patients are Palestinian men in their 30s who recently returned from Egypt. They are being held in quarantine in the border town of Rafah.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Asia > COVID-19 pandemic in Afghanistan
text: Afghanistan's Ministry of Public Health reports its first death from COVID-19, a 40-year-old man in Balkh Province.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Asia > COVID-19 pandemic in Uzbekistan
text: Uzbekistan orders companies in Tashkent to do remote working and makes protective masks as an effort to contain the coronavirus.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Asia > COVID-19 pandemic in mainland China, 2020 Hubei lockdowns
text: China reports only one domestic case of COVID-19 but reports 45 imported cases.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Asia > COVID-19 pandemic in mainland China, 2020 Hubei lockdowns
text: The Civil Aviation Administration of China says that flights to Beijing will be diverted to 12 Chinese airports for screening amid the coronavirus pandemic.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Asia > COVID-19 pandemic in Iraq
text: Iraq issues a lockdown until March 28 in an effort to contain the coronavirus.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Asia > COVID-19 pandemic in Turkey
text: Turkey's Ministry of Health reports that the country's COVID-19 death toll stands at 30, with a total of 1,236 confirmed cases.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Asia > COVID-19 pandemic in Syria
text: The government announces the war-torn country's first confirmed case of COVID-19.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Europe > COVID-19 pandemic in Italy
text: Italy raises its COVID-19 death toll to 5,476.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Europe > COVID-19 pandemic in Spain
text: Prime Minister of Spain Pedro Sánchez tells the Congress of Deputies the country will to extend its state of alarm, implemented due to the coronavirus, for an additional 15 days.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Europe > COVID-19 pandemic in Spain
text: Spain's Ministry of Health reports 394 more deaths from COVID-19, the highest number of deaths in a single 24-hour period in the country to date. The total number of confirmed cases now stands at 28,572 with 1,720 deaths. Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez says "the worst is yet to come".

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Europe > COVID-19 pandemic in Spain
text: Tenor Plácido Domingo announces he has tested positive for COVID-19.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Europe > COVID-19 pandemic in the Czech Republic
text: The Czech Republic reports the country's first death from COVID-19, a 95-year-old man from the capital city of Prague.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Europe > COVID-19 pandemic in Romania
text: Romania reports the country's first death from COVID-19, a 67-year-old man from the town of Filiași.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Europe > COVID-19 pandemic in France
text: French Health Minister Olivier Véran confirms the first death of a doctor treating COVID-19 patients.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Europe > COVID-19 pandemic in Greece
text: Prime Minister Kyriakos Mitsotakis orders a nationwide lockdown starting March 23.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Europe > COVID-19 pandemic in Andorra
text: Andorra reports its first death from COVID-19.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Europe > COVID-19 pandemic in Germany
text: Chancellor of Germany Angela Merkel self-isolates after being in contact with a doctor infected with COVID-19.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in South America > COVID-19 pandemic in Colombia
text: Riots break out at several prisons in Colombia over COVID-19 fears. Residents report explosions and gunfire inside La Modelo prison in the capital Bogotá. Inmates release a statement demanding the government allow vulnerable prisoners to be granted house arrest.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in South America > COVID-19 pandemic in Colombia
text: Colombian Justice Minister Margarita Cabello Blanco says 23 prisoners are dead and 83 others are injured following an attempted "mass criminal escape" at La Modelo prison and other detention centers. Two guards are also in critical condition.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in North America > COVID-19 pandemic in the United States > COVID-19 pandemic in New York
text: Former film producer and convicted sex offender Harvey Weinstein tests positive for COVID-19. He is put in isolation at the Wende Correctional Facility.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in North America > COVID-19 pandemic in the United States > COVID-19 pandemic in Ohio, COVID-19 pandemic in Louisiana
text: Louisiana declares a lockdown due to the coronavirus.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in North America > COVID-19 pandemic in the United States > COVID-19 pandemic in Ohio, COVID-19 pandemic in Louisiana
text: Ohio Governor Mike DeWine issues a stay-at-home order. Grocery stores, pharmacies and manufacturing industries deemed "essential" will remain open.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in North America > COVID-19 pandemic in the United States > COVID-19 pandemic in Maryland
text: Ocean City, Maryland announces that their beaches will be closed to slow down the spread of coronavirus.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in North America > COVID-19 pandemic in the United States
text: U.S. Senator from Kentucky Rand Paul tests positive for COVID-19. Mitt Romney and Mike Lee self-quarantine for 14-days despite not testing.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Australia
text: Prime Minister Scott Morrison announces the country is shutting down non-essential services effective midday Monday for pubs, clubs, gyms, cinemas and places of worship, while restaurants and cafes will have to switch to takeaway only. The number of cases in Australia has risen to 1,315.

context: Italy–Russia relations, COVID-19 pandemic in Italy
text: The Russian military sends medical help and disinfection tools to Italy to battle the coronavirus.

context: 2020 Guinean legislative election, 2020 Guinean constitutional referendum
text: Despite violent protests, boycotts from the political opposition and fears about potential coronavirus infections, legislative elections are held in Guinea next to a controversial referendum.

context: Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on sports > COVID-19 pandemic in Australia
text: The 2020 AFL season has been postponed to May 31 after South Australia and Western Australia close their borders to all non-essential travelers, and both New South Wales and Victoria engage a total lockdown.

context: Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on sports > Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on the 2020 Summer Olympics
text: Fans attend the Olympic flame despite the coronavirus.

context: Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on sports > Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on the 2020 Summer Olympics
text: After ruling out cancelling the Olympics, the International Olympic Committee considers postponing the Olympics to 2021. They set a deadline to decide within the next four weeks.

context: Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on sports > Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on the 2020 Summer Olympics
text: The Canadian Olympic Committee and Canadian Paralympic Committee announce that they will not be sending athletes to the Summer Games in 2020.

context: Boko Haram insurgency > March 2020 Chad and Nigeria massacres
text: Boko Haram jihadists kill 92 soldiers at an army base in Chad.

context: Boko Haram insurgency > March 2020 Chad and Nigeria massacres
text: Boko Haram kills 70 troops in an ambush in Borno, northeastern Nigeria.

Islamist militants seize the port town of Mocímboa da Praia in Cabo Delgado Province, Mozambique after capturing the town's military base in an overnight attack. Residents say militants have blocked all exits in the town. The armed forces and police launch a counter-offensive.
The Syrian Air Defense Force says that it intercepted a drone near Khmeimim Air Base.

context: Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on cinema > COVID-19 pandemic in mainland China
text: About 500 cinemas reopen in China.

context: Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on cinema > COVID-19 pandemic in Spain
text: Italian actress and former beauty pageant winner Lucia Bosè dies aged 89 from pneumonia complicated by COVID-19.

context: Economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic > Economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic in the Republic of Ireland, Economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom
text: Fast food restaurant chain McDonald's closes all of its restaurants in the United Kingdom and Ireland citing the safety of its employees and customers amid the coronavirus pandemic.

context: Economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic > Economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic in the United States
text: The United States Senate votes down for a second time a stimulus relief package.

context: Economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic > Economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic in the United States
text: The Federal Reserve Bank announces the commitment to buy any amount of government-backed securities needed to keep interest rates down. Among other measures being developed to support the real economy, it will also establish a special purpose vehicle allowing it to buy investment-grade corporate bonds directly.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Oceania
text: Vanuatu puts the island of Aneityum under "temporary lockdown" after a cruise ship with a reportedly infected passenger on board visited the island.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Oceania > COVID-19 pandemic in New Zealand
text: New Zealand enters alert level 3 after the investigation into two assumed community-spread cases do not find any links to travel. All schools and public venues are closed. The country will enter alert level 4 on 26 March at midnight local time.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Oceania > COVID-19 pandemic in Fiji
text: Fiji confirms its third case of COVID-19.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Europe > COVID-19 pandemic in Spain
text: Spain's Ministry of Health reports 4,000 new confirmed coronavirus cases, rising to 33,000 infected and 2,182 dead.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Europe > COVID-19 pandemic in Spain
text: The Spanish Army has found elderly people abandoned and dead inside retirement homes, according to Defence Minister Margarita Robles. A criminal investigation has been launched.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Europe > COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom
text: The British Army begins Operation Rescript, to assist the UK's efforts to tackle the coronavirus pandemic.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Europe > COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom
text: The United Kingdom is placed in lockdown. The new measures close all non-essential stores and ban gatherings of more than two people.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Europe > COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom
text: Downing Street says Foreign Secretary Dominic Raab is the "designated survivor" to replace Prime Minister Boris Johnson if he became "incapacitated" due to COVID-19. The clarification comes after the issue was raised by MP Peter Bone.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Europe > COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom
text: The British government announces that ExCeL London will be turned into a 4000-bed hospital to open next week, staffed primarily by military medics.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Europe > COVID-19 pandemic in the Netherlands
text: The Dutch Health Ministry reports 545 new confirmed cases of COVID-19 and 34 more deaths, bringing the total number of cases to 4,749 and 213 deaths.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Europe > COVID-19 pandemic in Malta
text: Malta's government announces that citizens who test positive for COVID-19 and disobey self-isolation rules will be fined 10,000 euros.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Europe > COVID-19 pandemic in Cyprus
text: President Nicos Anastasiades announces the order of a nationwide lockdown between 24 March and 13 April.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Asia > COVID-19 pandemic in Uzbekistan
text: The government announces that a lockdown of Tashkent will begin on March 24.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Asia > COVID-19 pandemic in Myanmar
text: Myanmar reports the country's first confirmed cases of COVID-19, the patients are a 36-year-old who had travelled back from the United States and a 26-year-old returning from the United Kingdom. Panic buying is reported in the country's largest city, Yangon.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Asia > COVID-19 pandemic in the United Arab Emirates
text: Dubai closes all restaurants, cafes and food locals for two weeks.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Africa > COVID-19 pandemic in Tunisia
text: President Kais Saied orders the army to deploy in the streets to enforce a lockdown in response to the coronavirus.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Africa > COVID-19 pandemic in South Africa
text: President Cyril Ramaphosa announces a 21-day nationwide lockdown effective from March 26, to contain the coronavirus, as the number of confirmed cases rises to 402. Soldiers will be deployed to help police enforce the lockdown.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Africa > COVID-19 pandemic in Sudan
text: Sudan's South Darfur state reports eight new cases of COVID-19, including two Egyptian soldiers of the United Nations–African Union Mission in Darfur (UNAMID).

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in North America > COVID-19 pandemic in Canada > COVID-19 vaccination in Canada
text: Prime Minister Justin Trudeau announces that Canada will spend $192M to develop a COVID-19 vaccine.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in North America > COVID-19 pandemic in Canada > COVID-19 pandemic in Ontario > COVID-19 pandemic in Toronto
text: Mayor of Toronto John Tory declares a state of emergency for the city of Toronto.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in North America > COVID-19 pandemic in Canada > COVID-19 pandemic in Ontario
text: Premier Doug Ford announces that non-essential businesses in Ontario are to be shut down for at least two weeks.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in North America > COVID-19 pandemic in Canada > COVID-19 pandemic in Quebec
text: Premier François Legault announces that non-essential businesses in Quebec are to be shut down for three weeks.
