context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in North America > COVID-19 pandemic in the United States > COVID-19 pandemic in Hawaii
text: Norwegian Jewel arrives at Honolulu after cutting its trip short due to COVID-19 and mechanical problems. No positive cases were confirmed among the passengers and crew members.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in North America > COVID-19 pandemic in the United States > COVID-19 pandemic in Massachusetts
text: Governor Charlie Baker orders all businesses and organizations not providing essential services to close until April 7, effective at noon on Tuesday. Baker states that he is not issuing a stay-at-home order, saying it "doesn't make sense from a public health point of view", but has directed the Massachusetts Department of Public Health to issue a stay-at-home advisory, limiting public gatherings to 10 people or less.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in North America > COVID-19 pandemic in the United States > COVID-19 pandemic in Michigan
text: Michigan Governor Gretchen Whitmer issues a stay-at-home order for all Michiganders except for essential services.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in North America > COVID-19 pandemic in the United States > COVID-19 pandemic in New York (state)
text: New York is expected to be the first state to test the treatment of coronavirus with blood from recovered patients.
Cuba sends doctors to Italy to fight the coronavirus.
The United States Marine Corps and the United Arab Emirates Armed Forces hold military exercises amid tensions with Iran.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on prisons
text: Rapper-turned-informant 6ix9ine requests an early prison release over fears of COVID-19.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Ghana
text: Eight people are arrested at a market in Ashaiman for violating restrictions while disinfection on the market began.

context: Capital punishment in the United States, Capital punishment in Colorado
text: Colorado abolishes the death penalty and commutes sentences of death row inmates.
The Pacific Gas and Electric Company is expected to plead guilty to 84 counts of manslaughter in the Camp Fire in 2018.
Bernie Sanders wins the Democrats Abroad primary.
The ancestor, Ikaria wariootia, of all animals with a bilateral body plan is discovered as a fossil in rocks of South Australia.

context: Terrorism in the United States, COVID-19 pandemic in Missouri
text: FBI agents shoot dead an armed man during an arrest operation in Belton, Missouri, U.S. The man was suspected of plotting a bombing attack, with far-right motivations, at a Kansas City hospital believed to be treating COVID-19 patients.

context: Economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic, COVID-19 pandemic in mainland China
text: The Badaling section of the Great Wall of China reopens to visitors.

context: Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on the 2020 Summer Olympics
text: After the Summer Olympics is postponed, the Tokyo station's Olympic countdown clock displaying the number of days until the Games (a local tourist attraction) is switched to show the current date and time.
64 Ethiopian illegal immigrants are found dead and 14 alive inside a cargo container on a lorry in Tete Province, Mozambique, apparently having died of asphyxiation.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Asia > COVID-19 pandemic in mainland China
text: Premier Li Keqiang says that the spread of the epidemic has been basically blocked and the outbreak controlled within China.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Asia > COVID-19 pandemic in mainland China > 2020 Hubei lockdowns, COVID-19 pandemic in Hubei
text: China is expected to end lockdowns on most of the Hubei province. Wuhan, the epicenter of the coronavirus, is expected to reopen on April 8.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Asia > COVID-19 pandemic in India, Indian local government response to the COVID-19 pandemic
text: Complete lockdowns are announced in 30 states and union territories of India in an effort to stop the spread of COVID-19.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Asia > COVID-19 pandemic in Nepal
text: Nepal enters in a total and nationwide lockdown for a week.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Asia > COVID-19 pandemic in Saudi Arabia
text: Saudi Arabia reports the country's first death from COVID-19, as the total number of cases rises to 767. The patient was an Afghan expatriate.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Oceania > COVID-19 pandemic in New Zealand
text: New Zealand reports 40 new cases of coronavirus.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Oceania > COVID-19 pandemic in Australia
text: Australia announces a nationwide lockdown, outlawing all travel interstate and overseas, and closing the nation's borders. Schools remain open in some locations.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Europe > COVID-19 pandemic in Spain
text: Spain's Ministry of Health reports 514 more deaths from COVID-19, the highest daily death toll in the country to date.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Europe > COVID-19 pandemic in Spain
text: The Palacio de Hielo ice rink in Madrid begins to be used as a morgue as the city's funeral homes are not able to hold all COVID-19 victims.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Europe > COVID-19 pandemic in France
text: Cameroonian musician and songwriter Manu Dibango dies from COVID-19 in Paris, France.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Europe > COVID-19 pandemic in France
text: France reports 2,444 new confirmed cases of COVID-19 and 240 more deaths, bringing the country's total to 22,300 cases and over 1000 deaths.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Europe > COVID-19 pandemic in Poland
text: The government introduces new measures over the ongoing coronavirus pandemic in the country: a ban on gatherings of more than two people, from the current 50. However, the number of people allowed to take part in religious services, including funerals, is limited to five. The new restrictions are to last until at least 11 April.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Europe > COVID-19 pandemic in Poland
text: Prime Minister Mateusz Morawiecki tells at a news conference on Tuesday that the presidential election, scheduled for 10 May, will not be affected by the coronavirus pandemic and will go ahead as planned.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Europe > COVID-19 pandemic in Vatican City
text: Roman Curia confirms three more cases, raising to four.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in South America > COVID-19 pandemic in Chile
text: Despite a week-long lockdown, Easter Island (Rapa Nui) reports its first case of coronavirus.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Africa > COVID-19 pandemic in Egypt
text: Egypt declares a two-week nationwide curfew between 7pm and 6am to prevent the spread of the virus. Those who break the curfew will be fined up to 4,000 pounds or be jailed, according to Prime Minister Mostafa Madbouly.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Africa > COVID-19 pandemic in Libya
text: The National Centre for Disease Control reports Libya's first confirmed case of COVID-19, a patient at a hospital in Tripoli. The World Health Organization has warned that the virus could cause Libya's already struggling health system to collapse.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in North America > COVID-19 pandemic in the United States > COVID-19 pandemic in California
text: The number of confirmed cases of COVID-19 in California reaches 2,226, with 42 deaths.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in North America > COVID-19 pandemic in the United States > COVID-19 pandemic in New York
text: U.S. Vice President Mike Pence says FEMA will send 4,000 ventilators to New York in the next 48 hours. The state now has at least 20,000 confirmed cases of COVID-19.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in North America > COVID-19 pandemic in the United States > COVID-19 pandemic in Michigan
text: Detroit Mayor Mike Duggan confirms nine members of the Detroit Police Department have tested positive for COVID-19, with one death, a 38-year-old male dispatcher. An additional 233 officers have been quarantined since Sunday.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in North America > COVID-19 pandemic in the United States > COVID-19 pandemic in Florida
text: Playwright Terrence McNally dies from complications of COVID-19 in Florida.
A man in the Chinese province of Yunnan dies after testing positive for hantavirus.

context: South Korea–United States relations, COVID-19 pandemic in the United States
text: South Korea President Moon Jae-in says that President Donald Trump asked the country to send medical equipment to the United States to help fight the coronavirus.
China launches three military surveillance satellites on a Long March 2C rocket.

context: Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on the 2020 Summer Olympics
text: The 2020 Summer Olympics has been postponed for the first time in the modern Olympic Games history to 2021 in response to the COVID-19 pandemic.

context: War in Afghanistan > Kabul gurdwara attack
text: Gunmen kill 25 worshippers at a gurdwara in Kabul, Afghanistan. ISIL claims responsibility.

context: Libyan Civil War > 2019–20 Western Libya offensive
text: Forces loyal to the GNA assault the Okba Ibn Nafa Air Base, west of Tripoli, while the Libyan National Army captures several towns near the Berber city of Zuwarah, including Zaltan, Jumayl and Ras Ajdir.

context: Economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Egypt
text: Egypt begins disinfection on the Giza pyramid complex as an effort to contain COVID-19.

context: Economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic > Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on cinema, COVID-19 pandemic in mainland China
text: China announces that The Avengers, Avengers: Age of Ultron, Avengers: Infinity War, Avengers: Endgame, Avatar, Inception, and Interstellar will be re-released in theaters following the end of their lockdowns as a hope to revive their cinemas.

context: Economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic in the United States
text: The United States Senate and the Trump administration reaches a $2 trillion stimulus package deal following talks with Treasury Secretary Steven Mnuchin. The bill passes, and is expected to go to the United States House of Representatives.
A magnitude 7.5 earthquake hits the Kuril Islands town Severo-Kurilsk in Russia's Far East.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Asia > COVID-19 pandemic in India
text: ​India goes under a nationwide lockdown to contain the coronavirus pandemic.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Asia > COVID-19 pandemic in the Palestinian territories
text: Palestine reports its first death from COVID-19 in the West Bank, the patient was a woman in her 60s.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in North America > COVID-19 pandemic in the United States
text: The United States has its deadliest COVID-19 day to date, with 223 related deaths.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in North America > COVID-19 pandemic in the United States > COVID-19 pandemic in New York (state)
text: New York City records 81 more deaths from COVID-19, bringing the city's death toll to 280. Mayor Bill de Blasio has warned that more than half of all New Yorkers could become infected.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Oceania > COVID-19 pandemic in New Zealand
text: New Zealand declares a national state of emergency as the number of confirmed COVID-19 cases rise to 205.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Oceania > COVID-19 pandemic in the Solomon Islands
text: Solomon Islands declare state of emergency due to COVID-19.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Oceania > COVID-19 pandemic in Samoa
text: Samoan Prime Minister Tuilaepa Aiono Sailele Malielegaoi announces that people will be fined for breaking the new restrictions of movement due COVID-19.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Europe > COVID-19 pandemic in Hungary
text: The Foreign and Commonwealth Office confirms that Steven Dick, a 37-year-old diplomat to their mission in Budapest, has died from COVID-19.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Europe > COVID-19 pandemic in Spain
text: Spain surpasses China in the number of COVID-19-related deaths and becomes the country with the second-most deaths, after an increase of 738 in a single day.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Europe > COVID-19 pandemic in Spain
text: First Deputy Prime Minister Carmen Calvo tests positive for COVID-19. She was admitted to hospital on Sunday and becomes the third member of the Spanish government to be diagnosed with the virus.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Europe > COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom
text: Charles, Prince of Wales tests positive for COVID-19 while Camilla, Duchess of Cornwall tests negative; both now self-isolate due to the health classifications.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Europe > COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom
text: The first death from COVID-19 is confirmed in the Channel Islands, an elderly patient at a hospital in Jersey.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Europe > COVID-19 pandemic in France
text: President Emmanuel Macron announces the launch of military and investments in their health system in an attempt to fight COVID-19.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Africa > COVID-19 pandemic in Mali, COVID-19 pandemic in Guinea-Bissau
text: The first COVID-19 cases are confirmed in Mali and Guinea-Bissau.
President Rodrigo Duterte signs a law granting him special temporary powers to direct the operations of private hospitals and take over public transportation.

context: Assassination of Jamal Khashoggi, Saudi Arabia–Turkey relations
text: Turkey indicts 20 Saudis for the assassination of Jamal Khashoggi.

context: Transportation in Dubai, COVID-19 pandemic in the United Arab Emirates
text: Dubai lifts their ban on trucks weighing 2.5 tonnes as an effort to contain COVID-19.
Former Ukrainian Foreign Minister Leonid Kozhara is arrested by security forces on charges of murdering advertising mogul Sergiy Starytsky.

context: 2020 Russian constitutional referendum, COVID-19 pandemic in Russia
text: President Vladimir Putin postpones a referendum on constitutional changes that could extend his time in office for two more six-year terms because of the COVID-19 pandemic. Putin's current term runs through 2024.

context: Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on politics > COVID-19 pandemic in the United States > COVID-19 pandemic in Ohio
text: The Ohio Senate passes a coronavirus relief bill, which includes extending mail-in voting for the Ohio primary by April 28.

context: Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on politics > COVID-19 pandemic in Kosovo, Government of Kosovo
text: A motion of no confidence filed by junior coalition partner Democratic League of Kosovo (LDK) against Prime Minister Albin Kurti passes with 82—32 votes, toppling the Kurti cabinet. Vetëvendosje now has 15 days to nominate a new Prime Minister.
sources: The New York Times via The Indian Express

text: A bomb explodes near a Sikh crematorium in Kabul, wounding a child and disrupting funerals for 25 people bombed and shot the day prior.
Malian opposition leader Soumaïla Cissé and six others are taken hostage by jihadists in the northern Tombouctou Region. Cissé's bodyguard was killed and two others injured in the ambush.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in North America > COVID-19 pandemic in the United States
text: The death toll from COVID-19 in the U.S. reaches 1,200. The total number of cases in the country is 83,097. The U.S. has surpassed China in number of active cases, making it the country with the most cases in the world.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in North America > COVID-19 pandemic in the United States > U.S. state and local government response to the COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Colorado
text: Colorado Governor Jared Polis issues a stay-at-home order until April 11.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in North America > COVID-19 pandemic in the United States > U.S. state and local government response to the COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in New Hampshire
text: New Hampshire Governor Chris Sununu issues a stay-at-home order until May 4.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Oceania > COVID-19 pandemic in Samoa
text: Samoa begins a national lockdown announced by the Prime Minister. Those who do not comply with the lockdown's requirements will be fined.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Europe > COVID-19 pandemic in Spain
text: The Congress of Deputies approves extending the Alarm Status until 12 April.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Europe > COVID-19 pandemic in Spain
text: Spain's Ministry of Health reports 655 more deaths from COVID-19, bringing the country's death toll to over 4,000.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Europe > COVID-19 pandemic in Spain
text: Real Madrid CF's Santiago Bernabéu Stadium is to be used to store medical materials.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Europe > COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom
text: The Department of Health and Social Care reports 103 more deaths from COVID-19, the highest daily death toll in the country to date, bringing the death toll in the United Kingdom to 578 and 11,658 confirmed cases.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Europe > COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom
text: An 84-year-old inmate at HMP Littlehey in Cambridgeshire has become the first UK prisoner to die from COVID-19, according to the Ministry of Justice.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Europe > COVID-19 pandemic in the Republic of Ireland
text: The Republic of Ireland reports 255 new confirmed cases of COVID-19 and 10 more deaths, doubling the country's death toll to 19. The median age of the 19 patients who have died is 79 years old.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Europe > COVID-19 pandemic in France
text: France reports 365 more deaths from COVID-19, bringing the country's total to 1,696. French health authorities say 3,375 people with the virus remain in serious condition requiring life support.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Europe > COVID-19 pandemic in Armenia
text: Ministry of Health confirms the first death in the country from COVID-19.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Asia > COVID-19 pandemic in mainland China
text: China announces that travel will be suspended to the country as imported cases increase.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Asia > COVID-19 pandemic in the United Arab Emirates
text: The United Arab Emirates is expected to impose night curfew to tackle COVID-19 as the country begins a nationwide disinfection campaign.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Asia > COVID-19 pandemic in Afghanistan
text: Afghanistan is to release 10,000 prisoners over the age of 55 in response to the coronavirus pandemic. Those released will not include members of the Taliban and ISIL.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in South America > COVID-19 pandemic in Nicaragua
text: Nicaragua reports the country's first death from COVID-19, a patient with HIV/AIDS.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in South America > COVID-19 pandemic in Venezuela
text: Venezuelan Vice President Delcy Rodríguez reports the country's first death from COVID-19.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Africa > COVID-19 pandemic in Ethiopia
text: Ethiopian President Sahle-Work Zewde pardons more than 4,000 prisoners in an attempt to prevent coronavirus spread.

context: Iran–United States relations, Iraq–United States relations
text: The United States Treasury Secretary imposes fresh sanctions on Iran, blacklisting 20 Iran- and Iraq-linked companies and individuals.
World leaders convene virtually to coordinate a response to the ongoing coronavirus pandemic.
The United States Justice Department announces charges against Venezuelan President Nicolás Maduro for drug trafficking, offering up to a $15 million award for his arrest.
Brenton Tarrant pleads guilty to murdering 51 people and attempting to murder 40 as well as a terrorism charge in relation to two mass shootings in Christchurch, New Zealand, on 15 March 2019.
A Texas man is arrested for making death threats to House Speaker Nancy Pelosi and other Democrats on Facebook.
The United States Space Force launches its first satellite into space aboard an Atlas V rocket.

context: Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on sports > 2020 WNBA draft
text: The WNBA draft will go as planned on April 17, but will be a virtual event due to the coronavirus.

context: Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on sports
text: The 2020 Indianapolis 500 will be delayed until August 23, marking the first time in history that the event will not be held in May.

context: Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on sports
text: The Candidates Tournament 2020 is suspended after seven of 14 matches, following Russia's closure of international air traffic.

context: Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on cinema > Cinema of China, COVID-19 pandemic in mainland China
text: China's Film Bureau closes cinemas that had re-opened after the epidemic's first wave, without giving a reason.

context: Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on religion
text: Pope Francis delivers a special Urbi et Orbi blessing in an empty Saint Peter's Square, praying for the end of the coronavirus pandemic and offering a plenary indulgence to repentant sinners before San Marcello al Corso's miraculous crucifix, which was moved from its original church in Rome two days ago.

context: Economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic in the United States
text: The House of Representatives passes a $2 trillion stimulus relief bill as an effort to save the economy during the coronavirus pandemic. President Donald Trump signs the bill.

One person is killed and 16 people are injured, four with life-threatening injuries, after a New York City Subway caught fire near the Central Park North–110th Street station in Harlem. The fire has been treated as suspicious.
Mount Merapi erupts in Indonesia, sending ash of 5 kilometers in the air.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Asia > COVID-19 pandemic in Uzbekistan
text: Uzbekistan reports the first death from COVID-19, a 72-year-old woman with underlying health conditions in the city of Namangan.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Asia > COVID-19 pandemic in Iran
text: In Iran, 300 people die and 1,000 people become ill after drinking methanol to save themselves from COVID-19.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Asia > COVID-19 pandemic in Iran
text: Olympic silver medalist Ehsan Haddadi tests positive for COVID-19.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Asia > COVID-19 pandemic in the Philippines
text: The Philippines passes a legislation granting emergency powers to President Rodrigo Duterte as part of its measures to deal with the coronavirus pandemic as confirmed cases rise to 707.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Asia > COVID-19 pandemic in Jordan
text: Jordan reports its first death from COVID-19, a woman in her 80s, as cases rise to 235.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Africa > COVID-19 pandemic in South Africa
text: South Africa reports its first two deaths from COVID-19, both occurring at hospitals in Western Cape province. The government also announces a 21-day lockdown as cases surpass 1,000.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Europe > COVID-19 pandemic in Italy
text: The number of people who tested positive in Italy jumps to 86,498, while the death toll rose to 9,134. Italy is the country with the highest death toll in the world and second for number of cases.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Europe > COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom
text: Prime Minister Boris Johnson tests positive for COVID-19. He will self-isolate at 10 Downing Street.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Europe > COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom
text: Secretary of State for Health and Social Care Matt Hancock tests positive for COVID-19.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Europe > COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom
text: The Department of Health and Social Care reports 185 more deaths from COVID-19, the highest daily death toll in the country to date, bringing the death toll in the United Kingdom to 769.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Europe > COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom
text: Scientists in Oxford are expected to recruit 510 adults without COVID-19 to test a COVID-19 vaccine.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Europe > COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom > COVID-19 pandemic in Scotland, Healthcare in Scotland
text: Hospitals in Scotland are expected to get testing kits from South Korea as an effort to increase testing for COVID-19.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Europe > COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom
text: A temporary mortuary is being built at Birmingham Airport, with capacity to hold up to 12,000 bodies as the virus spreads in the region.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Europe > COVID-19 pandemic in Russia
text: President Vladimir Putin orders that the week between 28 March and 5 April will be a nationwide paid holiday and declares the closing of all restaurants and shops during this week.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Europe > COVID-19 pandemic in Hungary
text: Prime Minister Viktor Orbán announces a two-week national lockdown in response to the coronavirus pandemic.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Europe > COVID-19 pandemic in Cyprus
text: Cyprus' government is set to release 50 prisoners in order to contain the spread of the virus in the island.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in North America > COVID-19 pandemic in the United States
text: New York Governor Andrew Cuomo announces that eight hospitals will be built as the number of cases in New York surge.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in North America > COVID-19 pandemic in the United States > COVID-19 pandemic in California
text: The USNS Mercy, which has 1,000 beds, arrives in Los Angeles to offer assistance during the COVID-19 crisis.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Tonga
text: Prime Minister Pohiva Tu'i'onetoa announces that the country would be under a lock-down between 29 March and 5 April.

context: China–United States relations, COVID-19 pandemic in the United States
text: Chinese leader Xi Jinping offers advice to United States President Donald Trump on how to contain the coronavirus pandemic.
North Macedonia becomes the 30th member of NATO after over a year of negotiations.
Abu Dhabi crown prince Mohammed bin Zayed Al Nahyan and Syrian President Bashar al-Assad discusses the COVID-19 pandemic on phone.

context: Misinformation related to the COVID-19 pandemic > Fox News controversies
text: Fox Business fires its primetime host Trish Regan after she claimed the coronavirus is a Democratic Party ploy to impeach President Donald Trump.

context: Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on sports > 2019–20 NBA season
text: The Utah Jazz announces that Rudy Gobert and Donovan Mitchell are cleared of coronavirus after becoming the first National Basketball Association players to test positive on March 11.

context: Yemeni Civil War, Saudi Arabian-led intervention in Yemen
text: In a televised address, Houthi leader Abdul-Malik Badreddin al-Houthi offers to release five Saudi prisoners of war in exchange for the release of dozens of Palestinian activists convicted by Saudi Arabia earlier this month.

context: Yemeni Civil War, Saudi Arabian-led intervention in Yemen
text: Several ballistic missiles fired from Yemen are intercepted over the Saudi capital Riyadh, and the southern city of Jizan.

context: COVID-19 pandemic in mainland China > 2020 Hubei lockdowns
text: Wuhan, where the coronavirus pandemic first started, starts lifting its two-month lockdown by restarting some metro services and reopening borders to returning residents, though outbound traffic is still restricted until April 8.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Africa > COVID-19 pandemic in Ghana
text: Ghana President Nana Akufo-Addo announces a two-week partial lockdown on 27th March 2020 for Greater Accra and Kumasi, beginning on 30th March 2020. He also announced the establishment of a special fund to combat the spread of the coronavirus pandemic.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Asia > COVID-19 pandemic in Brunei
text: Brunei reports its first death from COVID-19, a 64-year-old man, as confirmed cases rise to 115 in the country.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Asia > COVID-19 pandemic in Uzbekistan
text: A 39-year-old doctor dies after he secretly underwent self-treatment for COVID-19. He was hospitalized on March 26 in grave condition. The doctor had been in contact with Uzbekistan's "patient zero".

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Asia > COVID-19 pandemic in mainland China
text: China reports 45 cases of COVID-19, with all but 1 involving oversea travelling.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Asia > COVID-19 pandemic in the United Arab Emirates
text: The United Arab Emirates reports 63 new cases of COVID-19. The country extends a curfew and disinfections to April 5.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Asia > COVID-19 pandemic in the United Arab Emirates
text: Abu Dhabi crown prince Mohammed bin Zayed announces that a mobile drive through testing site has opened.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Asia > COVID-19 pandemic in India
text: Prime Minister Narendra Modi says India plans to turn some railway coaches, which have been idled under the country's stay-at-home order, into isolation wards for patients with coronavirus.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Europe > COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom
text: The Department of Health and Social Care reports 260 more deaths from COVID-19, the highest daily death toll in the country to date, bringing the United Kingdom's death toll to 1,019 with 17,089 confirmed cases. The patients included in the new figures were aged between 33 and 100 years old, with the majority being in England.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Europe > COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom
text: The National Exhibition Centre in Birmingham and Manchester Central Convention Complex are to be converted into NHS Nightingale Hospitals.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Europe > COVID-19 pandemic in Spain
text: Spain's Ministry of Health reports 832 more deaths from COVID-19, the highest daily death toll in the country to date, bringing the country's death toll to 5,690, as confimed cases rise to 72,248.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Europe > COVID-19 pandemic in Spain
text: Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez announces the cessation of all non-essential activity, leading the country to total lockdown during two weeks.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Europe > COVID-19 pandemic in Spain
text: Authorities in Madrid decide to stop using a Chinese rapid COVID-19 test kit, developed by Shenzhen Bioeasy Biotechnology, after research suggested it was not accurate enough with a rate of less than 30%.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Europe > COVID-19 pandemic in Russia
text: Russia announces that all borders will be closed effective March 30 to counter the spread of COVID-19. The new measure will not apply to Russian diplomats or drivers of freight trucks, among others.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Europe > COVID-19 pandemic in Russia
text: In Kabardino-Balkaria, registry offices ask newlyweds to confine the number of guests at the wedding ceremony to 10 people or to postpone the wedding since four cases of coronavirus infection have been reported in the republic.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Europe > COVID-19 pandemic in France
text: France reports 319 new deaths from COVID-19, bringing the country's death toll to 2,314 with 37,575 confirmed cases.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in North America > COVID-19 pandemic in the United States > COVID-19 pandemic in New York
text: New York Governor Andrew Cuomo confirms that 728 people died from coronavirus in New York.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in North America > COVID-19 pandemic in the United States > COVID-19 pandemic in Michigan
text: President Donald Trump approves Michigan's request for emergency declaration.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in North America > COVID-19 pandemic in Canada
text: Canadian Prime Minister Justin Trudeau announces that the country will deny flights to people who show symptoms of COVID-19.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in North America > COVID-19 pandemic in Canada
text: Sophie Grégoire Trudeau, wife of Justin Trudeau, says that she has recovered from coronavirus after testing positive on March 13.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in South America > COVID-19 pandemic in Uruguay
text: Former Minister of National Defence Rodolfo González Rissotto becomes the first confirmed death from COVID-19 in Uruguay.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in South America > COVID-19 pandemic in Bolivia
text: The Minister of Health reports the first death from COVID-19 in the country.

context: China–Pakistan relations, COVID-19 pandemic in Pakistan
text: China sends medical aid and experts to Pakistan to help it contain the coronavirus pandemic.

context: Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on politics > 2020 New York Democratic primary
text: New York postpones its primary from April 28 until June 23 due to the COVID-19 pandemic.

context: Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on aviation > COVID-19 pandemic in Hubei, COVID-19 pandemic in mainland China
text: China resumes domestic flights to the Hubei province. Wuhan is expected to resume flights on April 8.

context: Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on aviation > COVID-19 pandemic in Nepal
text: Nepal Airlines will allow rescue flights to take stranded tourists back to their countries, but only if embassies requested it.

context: COVID-19 pandemic in the United Arab Emirates, transportation in Dubai
text: The Dubai Roads and Transport Authority announces that the Dubai Tram and Dubai Metro will be suspended until April 5 as sterilization continues in Dubai.

context: Economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Michigan
text: The 2020 North American International Auto Show, originally scheduled from June 9–20 in Detroit, has been cancelled due to the designation of the TCF Center as a temporary hospital.

An IAI Westwind jet, chartered by the Philippine government for a medical evacuation flight to Haneda Airport in Japan, crashes upon takeoff at Ninoy Aquino International Airport in Manila. All eight people onboard are killed.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Oceania > COVID-19 pandemic in New Zealand
text: New Zealand's Ministry of Health reports its first death from COVID-19, a woman in her 70s.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Europe > COVID-19 pandemic in Andorra
text: Thirty-nine health workers from Cuba arrive in Andorra, as the country's confirmed cases and death toll per capita becomes one of the highest in the world.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in North America > COVID-19 pandemic in the United States > COVID-19 pandemic in New York
text: New York Governor Andrew Cuomo extends the stay-at-home order for non-essential workers to April 15.

context: North Korea–South Korea relations, Japan–North Korea relations, North Korea and weapons of mass destruction
text: North Korea fires two short-range ballistic missiles into the ocean, the latest in an unprecedented flurry of launches. Both South Korea and Japan condemn the launching.

After having been postponed several times, parliamentary elections are being held in war-torn Mali. The election is overshadowed by the recent kidnapping of the leading opposition politician Soumaïla Cissé and the first reported COVID-19 death in the country.

Coalition warplanes carry out an air raid on the Yemeni capital Sanaa, bombing the Presidential Palace compound, a military school and airbase adjacent to Sanaa International Airport. The Houthi-run Almasirah TV channel says 70 horses were killed in the raid on the school.

context: Somali Civil War, Somali Civil War (2009–present)
text: Abdisalan Hassan, governor of the Nugal region, is killed in a suicide bombing. Al-Shabaab claims responsibility.

context: Economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic, Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on sports > COVID-19 pandemic in the United States
text: USA Rugby files for chapter 11 bankruptcy citing "insurmountable financial constraints" amid the coronavirus pandemic.

context: COVID-19 pandemic in mainland China, 2020 Hubei lockdowns
text: Wuhan, the epicenter of the COVID-19 pandemic, reopens its stores and shopping centers.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in North America > COVID-19 pandemic in Canada > COVID-19 pandemic in Ontario
text: Premier Doug Ford extends the province's state of emergency for another two weeks.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in North America > COVID-19 pandemic in Panama
text: Panama's Ministry of Health reports a total of 989 cases of COVID-19 in the country, of which 24 people have died.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in North America > COVID-19 pandemic in the United States > U.S. state and local government response to the COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in New York City
text: The USNS Comfort arrives in New York City to relieve the area's hospitals of non-coronavirus patients.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in North America > COVID-19 pandemic in the United States > U.S. state and local government response to the COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in New York City
text: The USTA Billie Jean King National Tennis Center in Queens, New York City, will be converted into a temporary 350-bed field hospital to treat overflow patients from other hospitals in New York.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in North America > COVID-19 pandemic in the United States > COVID-19 pandemic in Virginia, COVID-19 pandemic in Maryland
text: Maryland Governor Larry Hogan and Virginia Governor Ralph Northam issue stay-at-home orders. Virginia's stay-at-home order will remain in effect until June 10.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in North America > COVID-19 pandemic in Mexico
text: Mexico declares a national health emergency and extends the suspension of all non-essential activities until April 30.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Asia > COVID-19 pandemic in Japan
text: Japanese comedian Ken Shimura dies from pneumonia several days after being diagnosed with COVID-19.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Asia > COVID-19 pandemic in Israel
text: Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and some of his cabinet members self-quarantine after an aide tests positive for COVID-19.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Asia > COVID-19 pandemic in Syria
text: The government reports the country's first death from COVID-19.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Asia > COVID-19 pandemic in Malaysia
text: Malaysia begins a nationwide disinfection to help curb the spread of COVID-19.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Europe > COVID-19 pandemic in Spain
text: Fernando Simón, Director of the Center for Coordination of Health Alerts and Emergencies of the Spanish Ministry of Health, becomes the second member of the Technical Committee to test positive for COVID-19.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Europe > COVID-19 pandemic in Denmark
text: Prime Minister Mette Frederiksen says that the country will lift lockdowns after Easter if COVID-19 cases and death numbers remain stable.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Europe > COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom
text: The Department of Health and Social Care reports 180 more deaths from COVID-19, bringing the United Kingdom's death toll to 1,415.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Europe > COVID-19 pandemic in France
text: France reports 418 more deaths from COVID-19, the highest daily death toll in the country to date, bringing the country's death toll to 3,024 and 44,550 cases.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Europe > COVID-19 pandemic in France
text: Former President of the People's Republic of the Congo Joachim Yhombi-Opango dies from COVID-19 at a hospital in Neuilly-sur-Seine. He is the first state leader (former or current) to have died from COVID-19.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Africa > COVID-19 pandemic in Botswana
text: Botswana reports their first confimed cases of COVID-19. Health Minister Lemogang Kwape says the three patients are currently in quarantine and had recently travelled to Britain and Thailand.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Africa > COVID-19 pandemic in Libya
text: The Government of National Accord (GNA) frees 466 prisoners from jails in Tripoli to prevent the spread of COVID-19. The GNA also announces an extended curfew from 2pm to 7am in the areas it controls.
The Singer Laren museum says that the Vincent van Gogh painting The Parsonage Garden at Nuenen was stolen in a raid.

context: Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on politics; COVID-19 pandemic in Hungary
text: Parliament votes 137 to 53 in favor of passing legislation to create a state of emergency without a time limit, grant Prime Minister Viktor Orbán the ability to rule by decree, suspend the parliament with no elections, and establish prison sentences for spreading fake news and leaving quarantine.

context: COVID-19 pandemic in Japan, Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on sports
text: After getting postponed a week before, the 2020 Summer Olympics has been rescheduled to July 23, 2021, while the 2020 Summer Paralympics is now taking place for August 24, 2021.

context: Economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic
text: G20 finance ministers said they will present an action plan to address the debt vulnerabilities, as well as delivering financial aid to emerging economies.

context: Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on aviation > COVID-19 pandemic in the United Arab Emirates
text: Dubai Crown Prince Sheikh Hamdan bin Mohammed Al Maktoum says that Dubai will provide financial assistance to Emirates Airlines.
Eighteen firefighters and their guide are killed by a forest fire in Liangshan, Sichuan, China.
A 6.5 magnitude earthquake happens west of Challis, Idaho, United States. It is the strongest earthquake in the state since 1983.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Oceania
text: The government of the Solomon Islands orders all schools closed to combat COVID-19.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Asia > COVID-19 pandemic in mainland China
text: China reports 48 imported cases of COVID-19.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Asia > COVID-19 pandemic in Myanmar
text: Myanmar reports the country's first death from COVID-19 as confirmed cases rise to 14. The patient was a 69-year-old man with cancer in Yangon.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Europe > COVID-19 pandemic in Belgium
text: A 12-year-old girl dies from COVID-19 in Belgium, becoming Europe's youngest victim to date.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Europe > COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom
text: The Department of Health and Social Care reports 393 more deaths from COVID-19, the highest daily death toll in the country to date, bringing the country's death toll to 1,789 and 25,150 cases.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Europe > COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom
text: A 13-year-old boy dies at the King's College Hospital, becoming the UK's youngest victim from the virus to date.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in North America > COVID-19 pandemic in the United States > COVID-19 pandemic in New York
text: The total number of cases in New York rises to over 75,000. The state's death toll reaches 1,550.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in North America > COVID-19 pandemic in the United States > COVID-19 pandemic in New York
text: Rep. Max Rose is expected to be deployed with the National Guard to New York as an effort to contain the coronavirus.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in North America > COVID-19 pandemic in the United States > COVID-19 pandemic in Guam
text: United States Navy Captain Brett Crozier requests urgent help from The Pentagon following an outbreak of COVID-19 aboard the USS Theodore Roosevelt aircraft carrier, which is currently docked in Guam. Crozier has recommended quarantining almost the entire crew of 4,000.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in North America > COVID-19 pandemic in the United States
text: The United States surpasses China in the number of deaths linked to COVID-19, as the death toll rises to 3,416, according to Johns Hopkins University.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in North America > COVID-19 pandemic in El Salvador
text: El Salvador's President Nayib Bukele confirms the country's first death from COVID-19.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Africa > COVID-19 pandemic in Burundi
text: Burundi reports the country's first cases of COVID-19. The patients are two Burundians, aged 56 and 42, who recently returned from the United Arab Emirates and neighbouring Rwanda.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Africa > COVID-19 pandemic in Sierra Leone
text: In a televised address, Sierra Leone's President Julius Maada Bio confirms the country's first case of COVID-19, a 37-year-old man who had recently travelled back from France.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Africa > COVID-19 pandemic in Senegal
text: Former President of French association football club Olympique de Marseille, Pape Diouf, dies from COVID-19 in Senegal, becoming the country's first fatality from the virus.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Africa > COVID-19 pandemic in South Africa
text: Prominent scientist and HIV/AIDS researcher Gita Ramjee dies from COVID-19 in Umhlanga, KwaZulu-Natal, South Africa.

context: United States–Venezuela relations, Venezuelan presidential crisis
text: In a policy shift, the United States proposes a "Democratic Transition Framework" which includes that both disputed Presidents, Nicolás Maduro and Juan Guaidó, step aside from the office.

context: COVID-19 pandemic in Asia > COVID-19 pandemic in Turkmenistan
text: Turkmenistan's government bans the usage of the word "coronavirus" in all public settings and also bans the use of face masks. The government maintains there are no cases in the country.

context: Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on politics > COVID-19 pandemic in the United States > COVID-19 pandemic in Wisconsin
text: The Wisconsin primary is expected to go as planned for April 7 despite coronavirus concerns.
Former Syrian Vice President Abdul Halim Khaddam dies of a heart attack in Paris, France.

The World Meteorological Organization will not retire any names from the 2019 Atlantic hurricane season this year due to the COVID-19 pandemic. Instead, retired names from that season, as well as the upcoming 2020 season, will be announced jointly during next year's annual spring meeting.

context: Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on sports > 2019–20 Chinese Basketball Association season, COVID-19 pandemic in mainland China
text: The Chinese Basketball Association delays the restart of its season due to the coronavirus pandemic.

context: Second Libyan Civil War > Turkish military intervention in the Second Libyan Civil War
text: A Turkish Naval Forces warship launches missiles at LNA positions near the city of Ajaylat in western Libya.

context: Second Libyan Civil War > Turkish military intervention in the Second Libyan Civil War
text: GNA forces say they shot down a Wing Loong drone used by the LNA over Ajaylat as clashes continue.

context: COVID-19 pandemic in the United States
text: Hobby Lobby is expected to reopen in states with stay-at-home orders.
Whiting Petroleum Corporation declares bankruptcy. Whiting was once the largest oil producer in the Bakken shale region.

Federal authorities charge 44-year-old Eduardo Moreno, a railroad engineer, with train-wrecking after he allegedly derailed a train near USNS Mercy to bring attention to the U.S. government's response to the pandemic.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Asia > COVID-19 pandemic in mainland China
text: China reports 130 asymptomatic cases of COVID-19. This is its first time reporting asymptomatic cases.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Asia > COVID-19 pandemic in Israel
text: Israeli Health Minister Yaakov Litzman tests positive for COVID-19 and will go into quarantine, as total number of cases in Israel rises to 6,092.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Asia > COVID-19 pandemic in Yemen, Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on prisons
text: Yemen's internationally recognised government releases more than 470 prisoners from detention facilities in areas under its control amid growing concerns the virus could spread in Yemen's overcrowded jails. The United Nations Human Rights Council has called for the release of all political prisoners.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in North America > COVID-19 pandemic in Cuba
text: The government announces that all flights to and from the island nation are suspended, as of midnight on April 1.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in North America > COVID-19 pandemic in the United States > COVID-19 pandemic in Florida
text: Governor Ron DeSantis issues a stay-at-home order.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Europe > COVID-19 pandemic in Italy
text: Italy extends its lockdown to April 13.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Europe > COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom
text: The Department of Health and Social Care reports 563 more deaths from COVID-19, the highest daily death toll in the country to date, bringing the country's death toll to 2,352 and 29,474 cases.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Europe > COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom
text: Chief Minister Howard Quayle confirms the Isle of Man's first death from COVID-19, a patient with underlying health conditions at Noble’s Hospital.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Europe > COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom
text: Former Prime Minister of Somalia Nur Hassan Hussein dies from COVID-19 in London.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Europe > COVID-19 pandemic in France
text: France reports 509 more deaths from COVID-19, bringing the country's death toll to 4,032 and 56,989 cases, with 6,017 of those patients reported in a serious condition requiring life support.

context: Russia–United States relations, COVID-19 pandemic in the United States
text: Russia is expected to send a plane with masks and medical supplies to the United States to help fight the COVID-19 pandemic.
United States President Donald Trump announces that United States Navy ships will be deployed to Venezuela on an anti-drug mission.

context: COVID-19 pandemic in the Dominican Republic
text: 19,517 people are arrested in the Dominican Republic for breaking curfew.
Grazia Zafferani and Alessandro Mancini are sworn in as Captains Regents of San Marino.

The United States Food and Drug Administration asks companies to stop selling all forms of the heartburn drug Ranitidine (Zantac). The agency says some medications contain a nitrosamine impurity called N-Nitrosodimethylamine (NDMA), a probable human carcinogen.
The number of confirmed cases of COVID-19 reaches more than one million worldwide.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Asia > COVID-19 pandemic in Lebanon
text: The Philippines ambassador to Lebanon, Bernardita Catalla, dies from COVID-19 in Beirut, according to the Department of Foreign Affairs.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Asia > COVID-19 pandemic in Taiwan
text: Taiwan donates 10 million masks to countries hardest hit by COVID-19.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Oceania > COVID-19 pandemic in Fiji
text: Fiji announces a lockdown of the capital Suva, beginning tomorrow, as two more cases are confirmed.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Europe > COVID-19 pandemic in Spain
text: Spain records its deadliest day with 950 deaths, exceeding 10,000, as employment falls by 834,000 jobs in 15 days.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Europe > COVID-19 pandemic in France
text: France reports 1,355 more deaths from COVID-19, the highest daily death toll in the country to date, bringing the country's death toll to 5,387, the new figures include deaths in retirement homes for the first time.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Europe > COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom
text: The Department of Health and Social Care reports 4,244 new cases and 569 more deaths from COVID-19, the highest daily death toll in the country to date, bringing the United Kingdom's death toll to 2,921 and 33,718 confirmed cases.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Europe > COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom
text: Scottish comedian and member of comedy double act Little and Large, Eddie Large, dies due to complications from COVID-19 at Southmead Hospital in Bristol.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Europe > COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom
text: The National Health Service announces that two more Nightingale field hospitals will be built at Harrogate Convention Centre in Harrogate, North Yorkshire, and the University of the West of England in Bristol.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Africa > COVID-19 pandemic in Zambia
text: Zambia reports the country's first death from COVID-19 as confirmed cases rise to 39; the patient had underlying health conditions, according to Health Minister Chitalu Chilufya.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Africa > COVID-19 pandemic in Malawi
text: In an address to the nation, President Peter Mutharika reports Malawi's first confirmed cases of COVID-19.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in South America > COVID-19 pandemic in Ecuador
text: The Mayor of Guayaquil, Cynthia Viteri, herself infected with COVID-19, condemns the federal government's response to the pandemic as the virus rapidly spreads inside the city. A joint military and police task force has collected at least 150 bodies off the streets. The government's spokesman Jorge Wated apologizes in a message broadcast on state television.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in the United States > COVID-19 pandemic in Guam
text: United States Navy Captain Brett Crozier is dismissed as the commander of the USS Theodore Roosevelt aircraft carrier after he publicly raised concerns about a COVID-19 outbreak on the ship. U.S. Navy Secretary Thomas Modly says the commander "exercised extremely poor judgement". At least 100 people aboard the vessel have been reportedly infected.
American rapper 6ix9ine is released early from prison due to coronavirus concerns.
A court in Pakistan overturns the convictions of four men for the murder of Daniel Pearl. The men have been jailed for 18 years.

context: Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on politics > 2020 Democratic National Convention
text: The Democratic National Convention is postponed from July 13 to August 17 due to COVID-19 concerns.

context: COVID-19 pandemic in the United States
text: United States President Donald Trump invokes the Defense Production Act to clear up supply-chain issues encountered in the manufacturing of ventilator machines.

Prague removes the controversial monument of Soviet General Ivan Konev, prompting anger from the Russian Embassy and Czech President Milos Zeman. Prague 6's local assembly voted to remove the Soviet-era monument in 2019.

context: Economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Europe
text: Ford Motor Company extends the suspension of vehicle and engine production at most of its manufacturing sites in Europe to May 4 due to the COVID-19 pandemic.

context: Economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in the Dominican Republic
text: The World Bank releases US$150 million to support the Dominican Republic's efforts to contain COVID-19.
Twenty-seven people died in Solomon Islands after their boat capsized during the Cyclone Harold.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Asia > COVID-19 pandemic in the Philippines
text: The Philippines records its single largest daily increase in casualties with 29 deaths, bringing the total deaths in the country to 136.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in North America > COVID-19 pandemic in the Dominican Republic
text: The Governor of the Duarte Province, Luis Núñez, tests positive for COVID-19 just after his wife dies from the virus.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Europe > COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom
text: The Department of Health and Social Care reports 684 more deaths from COVID-19, the highest daily death toll in the country to date, bringing the country's death toll to 3,605 and 38,168 confirmed cases.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Europe > COVID-19 pandemic in Switzerland, Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on prisons
text: Police surround the Champ-Dollon prison in Geneva, Switzerland, after dozens of prisoners refuse to return to their cells because of new coronavirus measures.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Europe > COVID-19 pandemic in Spain
text: Spain's Ministry of Health reports 7,500 new cases and 932 more deaths from COVID-19, bringing the country's death toll to 10,935 and 117,710 confirmed cases.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Europe > COVID-19 pandemic in Spain
text: The country overtakes Italy in the number of positives and becomes the second country in the world with more coronavirus cases.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in South America > COVID-19 pandemic in the Falkland Islands
text: The United Kingdom's Falkland Islands reports their first confirmed case of COVID-19. The patient is reported to be in stable condition at King Edward VII Memorial Hospital in Stanley.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in South America > COVID-19 pandemic in Suriname
text: Suriname reports the country's first death from COVID-19 as confirmed cases rise to 10.

Following criticism by the US government, the government of Sindh prevents the release of Ahmed Omar Saeed Sheikh and three other men. Yesterday, the Sindh High Court overturned their convictions for the murder of Daniel Pearl. The Pakistani Foreign Minister says the "[release] order shall be challenged at a higher forum".
Afghan intelligence agency National Directorate of Security announces that security forces have arrested 20 ISIL–KP fighters, including leader Aslam Farooqi.

Two people are killed and five others are injured in a mass stabbing in Romans-sur-Isère, Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes, France. A man from Sudan was arrested at the scene. The attack is treated and investigated as a terrorist incident.
A shootout between rival cartel gangs in Chihuahua, Mexico, kills at least 19 people.

context: Second Libyan Civil War > Turkish military intervention in the Second Libyan Civil War
text: Turkish-backed GNA forces say they have shot down three Sukhoi Su-22 jets belonging to forces loyal to Field marshal Khalifa Haftar.

context: Withdrawal of U.S. troops from Iraq
text: The United States-led CJTF–OIR hands over Al-Taqaddum Air Base to Iraqi security forces. It is the fourth military base to be returned to Iraq in recent weeks.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Europe > COVID-19 pandemic in Georgia
text: Georgia reports its first death from COVID-19; that of a 79-year-old woman who had other illnesses and underlying health conditions.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Europe > COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom
text: The Department of Health and Social Care reports 708 more deaths from COVID-19, the highest daily death toll in the country to date, bringing the UK's death toll to 4,313 and 41,903 confirmed cases.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Europe > COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom
text: A 5-year-old boy dies from COVID-19, becoming Europe's youngest victim of the virus to date. He had underlying health conditions.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Europe > COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom > Misinformation related to the COVID-19 pandemic
text: At the British government's daily press briefing on the coronavirus pandemic, Minister for the Cabinet Office Michael Gove condemns conspiracy theories being spread on social media about 5G spreading COVID-19. Several 5G telecommunications masts have been set on fire in recent days in Birmingham and Merseyside.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Europe > COVID-19 pandemic in France
text: France reports 1,053 more deaths from COVID-19, raising the country's death toll to 7,560 and 89,953 cases. The new figures include previously unreported deaths in retirement homes.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Asia > COVID-19 pandemic in Kuwait
text: Kuwait reports its first death from COVID-19 as cases reach 479.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Asia > COVID-19 pandemic in Turkey, Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on prisons
text: Turkey deploys the Gendarmerie General Command to the eastern city of Batman after a riot erupts inside the city's Type-M prison. The riot comes after the Turkish parliament approved the release of 100,000 inmates due to COVID-19, but excluded journalists and political prisoners, many of whom are Kurds.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Oceania
text: The President of New Caledonia Thierry Santa self-quarantines after a member of his crisis management team tested positive for COVID-19.
Sir Keir Starmer wins the 2020 Labour Party leadership election in the United Kingdom and becomes Leader of the Labour Party and Leader of the Opposition.

Chilean president Sebastián Piñera takes pictures in an empty Plaza Baquedano, symbol of mass protests calling for his resignation. The image provokes outrage after the protests were halted due to the coronavirus pandemic and a quarantine was declared.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Africa > COVID-19 pandemic in South Sudan
text: South Sudan Vice President Riek Machar confirms the country's first case of COVID-19. The patient is a 29-year-old woman who had arrived from Ethiopia in February and is now in isolation.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Africa > COVID-19 pandemic in Egypt
text: Former Libyan Prime Minister Mahmoud Jibril dies in Egypt from COVID-19 at the age of 67.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Africa > COVID-19 pandemic in Ethiopia
text: The government confirms its first death from COVID-19.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Africa > COVID-19 pandemic in Morocco
text: King Mohammed VI of Morocco pardons 5,654 prisoners and orders new measures to protect inmates from COVID-19. The prisoners were selected on the basis of their age, frail health, time spent in prison and good conduct.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in North America > COVID-19 pandemic in the United States > COVID-19 pandemic on USS Theodore Roosevelt
text: United States Navy Captain Brett Crozier, recently relieved of his command of the aircraft carrier USS Theodore Roosevelt after his letter pleading for aid for the coronavirus outbreak aboard his ship was leaked to the press, tests positive for COVID-19.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in North America > COVID-19 pandemic in the United States > COVID-19 pandemic in New York (state)
text: New York reports 8,327 new confirmed cases and 594 more deaths from COVID-19, bringing the state's death toll to 4,159 and 122,000 cases, according to Governor Andrew Cuomo.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in North America > COVID-19 pandemic in Haiti
text: Haiti reports the country's first death from COVID-19, a 55-year-old man with underlying health conditions.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Europe > COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom
text: Prime Minister Boris Johnson is admitted to hospital 10 days after testing positive for COVID-19.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Europe > COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom
text: Queen Elizabeth II gives an address to the nation, just the fifth such event in the monarch's 68-year reign, where she compares social isolation to the world war evacuations, thanks the public for their resilience and the world for unifying.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Europe > COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom > COVID-19 pandemic in Scotland
text: Scotland's Chief Medical Officer Catherine Calderwood resigns after breaking her own rules on COVID-19 restrictions by visiting her second home in Elie and Earlsferry. She had been warned by police about her conduct.
Five people are killed in a mass shooting in Yelatma, Ryazan Oblast, Russia. The suspect has been arrested and said he shot dead four men and one woman for "talking too loudly".

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Africa > COVID-19 pandemic in Malawi
text: President Peter Mutharika announces a stimulus package to alleviate the economic stress resulting from the disease. To help finance this program, he and all government ministers are taking a ten percent wage cut for three months.

context: Misinformation related to the COVID-19 pandemic
text: YouTube says it will remove videos promoting a conspiracy theory linking 5G to COVID-19, while "borderline content" will be removed from search results. The decision comes after four more mobile phone masts are set on fire, and broadband engineers have received threats, in several UK cities.
Gunmen on motorbikes attack a military base in Bamba, Gao, Mali, killing at least 25 soldiers. No group has claimed responsibility for the attack.

context: Economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic, COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom
text: British department store retailer Debenhams files for administration due to "unprecedented" circumstances caused by the United Kingdom's coronavirus lockdown.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Europe > COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom
text: Prime Minister Boris Johnson is admitted to intensive care at St Thomas' Hospital in London as his COVID-19 symptoms worsen. Foreign Secretary Dominic Raab, as First Secretary of State, will assume Johnson's duties while he remains in the ICU.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Europe > COVID-19 pandemic in France
text: France reports 833 more deaths from COVID-19, the highest number of deaths recorded in a single day, bringing the country's death toll to 8,911 and the number of cases to 98,010. Health Minister Olivier Véran says, "We have not reached the end of the ascent of this epidemic."

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Europe > COVID-19 pandemic in France
text: President Emmanuel Macron eases some lockdown restrictions for people on the autism spectrum following the requests of disability groups.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in North America > COVID-19 pandemic in Barbados
text: Barbados reports its first death from COVID-19, an 81-year-old man with diabetes who recently travelled to the United Kingdom.

context: Economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic, COVID-19 pandemic in Ivory Coast
text: Police and protesters clash in Ivory Coast, after the latter dismantled a half-built COVID-19 testing center over fears that people using the facility would spread the virus through their district.

context: Right-wing terrorism in Russia, Russia–United States relations
text: In an unprecedented move, the Trump administration designates a white supremacist group, based in Russia, as a terrorist organization, and imposes individual sanctions on its leaders. The organization, , is believed to have trained the perpetrators of a series of terrorist attacks in Gothenburg, Sweden, in 2016.

context: Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on politics > 2020 Wisconsin Democratic primary, 2020 Wisconsin Republican primary, COVID-19 pandemic in Wisconsin
text: The Wisconsin Supreme Court overturns Governor Tony Evers's order to postpone tomorrow's primary elections. Furthermore, the Supreme Court of the United States rules 5–4 in favor of the Republican National Committee to overturn a lower court decision extending absentee ballot eligibility in the Wisconsin primary election to those ballots postmarked by April 13, ruling that ballots postmarked after April 7 will be invalidated.

context: Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on politics > COVID-19 pandemic in Poland, 2020 Polish presidential election
text: Deputy Prime Minister Jarosław Gowin tenders resignation over disagreement with the ruling Law and Justice (PiS) party as to the upcoming presidential election. He stated at a press conference that the election scheduled for May 10, should be postponed, while the government pushes for the election amid the coronavirus pandemic. Gowin also resigns as Minister of Science and Higher Education.

context: Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on politics > COVID-19 pandemic in Poland, 2020 Polish presidential election
text: Polish MPs, with 230–226 votes and two abstained, pass a bill under which the presidential election in May will be held by postal vote only. The bill now goes to the upper house, the Senate, for debate.

context: War in Afghanistan; Afghan peace process
text: A Taliban spokesman says that the group has recalled its negotiators with the government in response to the latter's refusal to release Taliban prisoners. The Taliban also announces it could increase violence against government forces. In response, the government asks the Taliban not to "sabotage the process".

A major blackout is reported in western and southern Libya, according to the General Electricity Company of Libya, which says its control teams are trying to figure out the reason behind the power outage.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Asia > COVID-19 pandemic in Japan
text: Prime Minister Shinzo Abe declares a state of emergency to combat COVID-19.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Asia > COVID-19 pandemic in the Philippines > 2020 Luzon enhanced community quarantine
text: President Rodrigo Duterte extends the lockdown and home quarantine measures on Luzon until April 30.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Asia > COVID-19 pandemic in Lebanon, Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on prisons
text: A riot breaks out at Qubbah prison in Tripoli, Lebanon, with reports of a "number of injuries". In a separate incident, Lebanese security forces thwart a mass escape attempt at a prison in Beqaa Governorate, which relatives of inmates say is linked to fears of COVID-19.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Europe > COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom
text: The Department of Health and Social Care reports 854 more deaths from COVID-19, the highest daily death toll in the country to date, bringing the UK's death toll to 6,159 and 55,242 confirmed cases.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Europe
text: Officials in the breakaway region of Nagorno-Karabakh report its first confirmed case of COVID-19, a patient who had recently returned from Armenia.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Europe > COVID-19 pandemic in France
text: France reports 1,417 more deaths from COVID-19, the highest daily death toll in the country to date, raising the country's death toll to 10,238.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in North America > COVID-19 pandemic in the United States > COVID-19 pandemic in New York
text: New York Governor Andrew Cuomo reports 731 more deaths in the state from COVID-19, the highest daily death toll in the state to date, bringing the state's death toll to 5,489 and 138,836 infections.

context: Catholic Church sexual abuse cases in Australia
text: George Pell wins his appeal in the High Court of Australia against child sexual abuse convictions.
Former President of Ecuador Rafael Correa is found guilty on corruption charges and sentenced to eight years in prison. Correa is also banned from participating in politics until 2045.

context: 2020 Democratic Party presidential primaries, 2020 Republican Party presidential primaries > 2020 Wisconsin Democratic primary, 2020 Wisconsin Republican primary
text: Voters in Wisconsin go to the polls in their primary elections.

context: COVID-19 pandemic on USS Theodore Roosevelt
text: Acting Secretary of the Navy Thomas Modly resigns amid controversy surrounding his comments regarding Captain Brett Crozier, former commanding officer of the aircraft carrier USS Theodore Roosevelt. Modly had referred to Crozier, whom he relieved of command on 3 April, as "too naïve or too stupid" to be in command following the leak of a letter the captain had sent pleading for help with the COVID-19 outbreak on his ship.
Former CNN contributor and press secretary for Donald Trump's 2020 presidential campaign Kayleigh McEnany is appointed as the new White House Press Secretary.
Astronomers report, via The Astronomer's Telegram, that comet C/2019 Y4 (ATLAS) appears to have disintegrated.
Donald Trump signs an executive order encouraging Americans to resist international restrictions on mining celestial objects, should the situation arise.

context: Yemeni Civil War, Saudi Arabian-led intervention in Yemen
text: The Saudi Arabian-led coalition declares a unilateral ceasefire in its military action against Houthi forces in Yemen. The ceasefire, which supports UN efforts to end the five-year-old war, will be effective Thursday.

context: Syrian civil war, Use of chemical weapons in the Syrian Civil War
text: The Organisation for the Prohibition of Chemical Weapons finds there are "reasonable grounds to believe" that the Syrian Air Force was responsible for three chemical weapon attacks in March 2017 that affected 106 people in the opposition-held village of Al-Lataminah.

context: Economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic
text: Following a collapse in print sales amid the COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom, The Jewish Chronicle and Jewish News newspapers enter voluntary liquidation and are to close.
Cyclone Harold hits Fiji.
A bridge between the towns of Caprigliola and Albiano Magra in Tuscany, Italy, collapses. It results in only minor injuries of two truck drivers.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Asia > COVID-19 pandemic in mainland China
text: China ends the lockdown in Wuhan, as controls on outbound travel in Wuhan are officially lifted just after Tuesday midnight.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Asia > COVID-19 pandemic in Saudi Arabia
text: Prince and governor of Riyadh Region Faisal bin Bandar Al Saud is admitted to an intensive care unit after testing positive for COVID-19. It's reported that at least 150 members of the royal family have been infected.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Europe > COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom
text: The Department of Health and Social Care reports 936 more deaths from COVID-19, the highest daily death toll in the country to date, bringing the UK's death toll to 7,095.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Europe > COVID-19 pandemic in Malta
text: Malta reports its first death from COVID-19, a 92-year-old woman with underlying health problems, as total cases rise to 299.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Africa > COVID-19 pandemic in Somalia
text: Somalia reports its first death from COVID-19 as the cases reach 12.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in North America > COVID-19 pandemic in the United States > COVID-19 pandemic in Michigan
text: Michigan becomes the third state to surpass 20,000 cases of COVID-19, after New York and New Jersey. As of this date, Michigan has 20,346 confirmed cases with 959 deaths.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in North America > COVID-19 pandemic in the United States > COVID-19 pandemic in New York
text: New York Governor Andrew Cuomo reports 779 more deaths from COVID-19 in the state, the highest daily death toll in the state to date, bringing its death toll to 6,268, with 149,316 total cases.
The Sultan of Oman, Haitham bin Tariq, pardons 599 prisoners, including 336 foreigners.
Senator Bernie Sanders suspends his presidential campaign, leaving former Vice President Joe Biden as the presumptive nominee of the Democratic Party for President in the general election.
Five rockets hit Bagram Airfield in Afghanistan, with no casualties reported. The Taliban denies responsibility and ISIL claims responsibility.

context: Economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic, 2020 Russia–Saudi Arabia oil price war
text: OPEC+ holds an emergency meeting to try to agree on output cuts due to decreased demand for oil due to the coronavirus pandemic. Russia says it has "no plans to discuss oil markets with the leadership of Saudi Arabia or the U.S. on Thursday".

context: 2019–20 South Pacific cyclone season > Cyclone Harold
text: Cyclone Harold hits Tonga.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Europe > COVID-19 pandemic in Germany
text: The Robert Koch Institute reports 4,974 new confirmed cases and 246 more deaths from COVID-19, bringing Germany's death toll to 2,107 and 108,202 cases. This marks the largest daily increase of deaths for Germany.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Europe > COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom
text: The Department of Health and Social Care reports 881 more deaths from COVID-19, bringing the UK's death toll to 7,978 with 65,077 total confirmed cases.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in Europe > COVID-19 pandemic in Spain
text: Spanish Congress of Deputies approves an extension of the State of Alarm to 26 April. With more than 140.000 reported cases, the country becomes the second in the world with number of cases, overtaking Italy.

context: COVID-19 pandemic > COVID-19 pandemic in North America > COVID-19 pandemic in the United States > COVID-19 pandemic in Michigan
